added.title: Director of Infrastructure
added.description:
About Kirkland & Ellis

At Kirkland & Ellis, we don’t just meet the standard for legal excellence — we set it. Our culture is built on teamwork, ingenuity and an unwavering commitment to continuous growth. We tackle the most sophisticated legal challenges with bold ideas and innovative solutions, powered by the exceptional experience and ambition of our 7,000+ people, including 4,000+ attorneys, across 24 offices worldwide. Our dedicated professionals share our lawyers’ commitment to excellence and show up each day to do meaningful work that helps drive global business, investment and innovation forward.

What You’ll Do

Are you a transformational infrastructure leader who thrives on building secure, resilient, and high-performing technology environments at global scale?

As Director of Infrastructure, you will report to the Chief Information Officer and lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of the technology platforms that support more than 7,000 attorneys and business professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Leading a global team of approximately 60 professionals through six functional leaders, you will oversee a diverse infrastructure portfolio spanning data centers, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, enterprise networks, telecommunications, collaboration platforms, databases, storage, compute, and identity management.

This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for a technology executive who can balance long-term strategy with operational excellence. You will partner closely with Information Security, Applications, and senior business leaders to strengthen resilience, modernize critical platforms, enable Artificial Intelligence (AI) adoption, and ensure the secure delivery of world-class technology services in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.

Shape Infrastructure Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year infrastructure roadmap that supports business growth, client service excellence, operational efficiency, and AI-enabled innovation.
Lead Modernization Initiatives: Drive cloud adoption, network transformation, unified communications initiatives, automation programs, and enterprise technology modernization efforts.
Enable Enterprise AI: Partner with technology and security leaders to establish the infrastructure, governance, identity, data, and network foundations required for Microsoft 365 Copilot and other AI-driven solutions.
Deliver Reliable Global Services: Ensure 24/7 availability, performance, scalability, and service quality across infrastructure platforms that support business-critical operations worldwide.
Drive Operational Excellence: Champion Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) best practices across change, incident, problem, and configuration management while improving monitoring, automation, and service reliability.
Lead Through Critical Events: Act as the senior escalation point during major outages, cybersecurity incidents, and recovery efforts, coordinating cross-functional teams to restore services and minimize business impact.
Oversee Core Technology Domains: Provide leadership across cloud and data center operations, networks, telecommunications, messaging and collaboration, storage, databases, backup and recovery, and Identity and Access Management (IAM).
Strengthen Risk and Resilience: Lead Disaster Recovery (DR) strategy, testing, ransomware preparedness, recovery capabilities, and infrastructure governance to support security, compliance, and client expectations.
Manage Investment and Vendor Partnerships: Oversee infrastructure budgets, technology investments, vendor relationships, contract negotiations, sourcing strategies, and cost optimization initiatives.
Develop High-Performing Teams: Coach and inspire a global organization of infrastructure professionals, building leadership capability, succession plans, technical expertise, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Influence Executive Stakeholders: Communicate infrastructure strategy, operational performance, technology risks, and investment priorities clearly to senior leadership and business partners.

What You’ll Bring

Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Advanced degrees and certifications such as ITIL, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or Project Management Professional (PMP) are a plus.
Deep Leadership Experience: 15+ years of progressive enterprise infrastructure experience, including at least seven years leading managers and multidisciplinary teams within large, globally distributed environments.
Enterprise Infrastructure Expertise: Demonstrated success managing complex hybrid environments spanning cloud and on-premises technologies at enterprise scale.
Transformation Leadership: Proven experience delivering large-scale cloud migrations, data center consolidations, network modernization programs, or unified communications transformations.
Service Management Excellence: Strong command of ITIL-based service delivery practices, operational governance, and continuous improvement methodologies.
Financial & Vendor Acumen: Experience managing substantial technology budgets, optimizing costs, negotiating contracts, and governing strategic vendor relationships.
Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business recommendations and build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
Crisis Leadership & Resilience: Demonstrated ability to lead through high-pressure incidents, cybersecurity events, and recovery scenarios with sound judgment and decisiveness.
Professional Services Mindset: Experience in a law firm, consulting organization, Big Four firm, or other highly client-focused, confidentiality-driven environment is preferred.
Integrity & Collaboration: A track record of earning trust, influencing through credibility, and handling sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

If you’re excited to shape global infrastructure strategy, lead transformative technology initiatives, and build the resilient foundation that powers exceptional client service, we’d love to hear from you for this Director of Infrastructure opportunity.

Compensation

The base salary range below represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position in Chicago. This range may differ based on your geographic location and cost of living considerations. At Kirkland & Ellis, we consider compensation more than just a base salary. We offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits including comprehensive healthcare, paid time off, and retirement. We also offer personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

Compensation Range

Chicago: $308,000 - $385,000

How to Apply

Thank you for your interest in Kirkland & Ellis LLP. To complete an application and submit your resume, please click "Apply Now."

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others at Kirkland.

Work Schedule

Environmental Conditions

Office

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Discover Impactful Work

The Senior Manager, Application Science - Software Workflow and Strategy, leads a team that represents the scientific voice of the customer across the Genetic Sciences Division software portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of genetics, AI, laboratory workflows, and software development, translating customer needs and scientific use cases into actionable guidance for software teams.

This leader brings deep domain expertise in genetics or proteomics workflows, strong fluency in scientific software development, and the ability to work effectively across Product Management, UX, Software Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams. This is not a hands-on software development role; rather, it requires someone who can translate scientific and workflow needs into actionable guidance for software teams. A critical part of the role is helping define how AI, automation, and evolving lab-in-the-loop workflows can make genetic and proteomic scientists more effective by simplifying workflows, supporting interpretation, and reducing manual effort. The successful candidate will connect strategy to execution, helping shape future direction while ensuring teams can act on it effectively.

Location

This is a fully onsite role based at our South San Francisco, CA office. Carlsbad, CA and Pleasanton, CA may also be considered as alternative work locations. Relocation assistance is not provided for this position.

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

Lead and develop a high-performing team that represents customer scientific workflows across the GSD software development lifecycle.
Provide domain leadership in genetics and proteomic workflows to ensure software solutions align with real laboratory needs.

Strategy and Workflow Direction

Partner with Product Management to provide scientific and workflow input into software strategy, roadmap planning, and long-range priorities.
Help define future-state laboratory workflows, including how AI and automation can improve the experience of genetic scientists, and translate that vision into actionable guidance for software teams.

Customer and Workflow Translation

Engage with customers, key opinion leaders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow pain points, unmet needs, and emerging expectations.
Translate scientific and workflow insights into clear use cases, requirements guidance, and development inputs for software teams.

Cross-Functional and Team Leadership

Work effectively across Product Management, UX, Software Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to guide scientifically grounded software decisions in a matrixed environment.
Lead through influence while building team capability, driving strong execution, and connecting strategic priorities to day-to-day action.

Keys to Success

Education

Advanced degrees in Genetics, Proteomics, Genomics, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field, with significant experience in genetics or genomics, including hands-on understanding of laboratory workflows, downstream analysis, and biological interpretation.

Experience

Demonstrated interest in and practical understanding of how AI can improve scientific software and laboratory workflows.
Proven ability to think strategically and contribute to future workflow and software direction, not just tactical execution.
Demonstrated ability to lead people and influence cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment, including effective partnership across Product Management, UX, Software Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams.

Preferred

Familiarity with responsible AI, workflow automation, and decision-support concepts in regulated environments.
Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory environments, including FDA, ISO 13485, IVDR, or forensic accreditation standards, where applicable.

Leadership Profile

Ability to connect strategy to roadmap and drive successful execution
Demonstrated leadership in a matrixed environment
Ability to lead and develop high-performing teams
Strong judgment and comfort operating in ambiguity
Innovation mindset balanced with scientific rigor and customer trust

Approximately 20-30%, including customer visits, internal meetings, workshops, conferences, and cross-site collaboration.

added.description:
About Palladium

Operating in over 50 countries, Palladium is a global consulting and implementation company working in partnership with governments, businesses, investors, and communities to design and deliver solutions that create lasting positive impact. We address some of the world’s most complex challenges across infrastructure, economic growth and natural capital, health, energy, climate and environment, and digital transformation—strengthening systems, institutions, and markets to support inclusive and sustainable development. Our more than 2,100 staff worldwide work as trusted advisors across diverse contexts, combining deep technical expertise, implementation techniques, and innovative technology to deliver locally informed, client-focused solutions that help organizations achieve measurable, sustainable impact.

Palladium is part of GISI’s global family of companies, which aims to create solutions for the world’s most complex challenges. With annual revenues of $14 billion, GISI’s approximately 15,000 employees are engaged in projects across 100 countries worldwide providing construction, program/project management, and engineering consulting services.

This Opportunity

The Sustainable Infrastructure team, part of the broader Economic Growth & Natural Capital (EGNC) Portfolio, partners with mining companies to design and implement positive impact programs—such as workforce skilling, reforestation, and sustainable agriculture—that benefit mining communities and regions. The team works across the entire mining life cycle, helping clients achieve ESG targets while building the foundation for community resilience beyond mine closure. The team draws on expertise from the wider EGNC portfolio, which also works with private sector clients as well as philanthropic bodies and diverse donors (IDB, USDA, AFD, WB) to support agricultural value chain development, enhance women’s access to finance, and mobilize capital for climate-positive initiatives. Overall, the business seeks to unlock and scale innovative solutions that drive inclusive growth and deliver sustainable value for communities

Palladium is seeking a Senior Manager, Sustainable Infrastructure – Environment
to lead team management and provide technical expertise across business development and project delivery in environmental risk management, impact strategy, and implementation, particularly within mining, infrastructure, climate, and nature-based solutions. The role requires strong expertise in environmental risks in mining, including experience designing and implementing environmental management plans, and overseeing biodiversity, decarbonization, major hazards, tailings, waste, water, air, and rehabilitation initiatives. Candidates should have experience in the closure phase of the asset lifecycle, including Post Mining Land Use planning and program design, and demonstrate a track record of working with diverse mining clients in North America. The position also supports business development efforts such as strategic planning, pipeline forecasting, proposal development, partnerships, networking, and recruitment. Fluency in English and one additional language – French, Spanish, or Portuguese is required.

Location and Compensation:

The position can be based out of Palladium’s Arlington, VA office
or remote in the United States (only some states may be considered)
. Applicants must have current/future work authorization in the US as visa sponsorship cannot be provided.

The annual base salary for this position is expected to range from $120,000 to $140,000
. Please be advised that a final salary offer will be based on various factors, including but not limited to your qualifications, education, experience, skills, seniority, performance, and Palladium’s business or organizational needs.

This role is also posted in the UK; however, there is only one available position.

Reporting Lines

This role reports to the Director, Sustainable Infrastructure (UK based)

Primary Roles And Responsibilities

Project Management

Lead multidisciplinary project teams to deliver high-quality, client-focused results across complex assignments
Oversee proposal development, budgeting, project planning, implementation, and reporting to ensure timely and effective delivery
Identify, engage, and manage partners and subcontractors to strengthen technical quality and delivery capacity
Manage partner and subcontractor performance to ensure contractually compliant delivery of agreed inputs, outputs, and outcomes
Serve as Project Director, providing quality assurance for deliverables and oversight of budgets, client relationships, and overall project performance

Business Development

Contribute to the identification, assessment, and pursuit of new business opportunities with a focus on opening business with new clients and broadening Palladium’s work in the closure and environmental performance space and ability to leverage their own network activating new client portfolios quickly
Contribute to the preparation of technical proposals principally targeting private sector and blended finance opportunities with mining sector clients (focus on impact program design & implementation, work with standards setting bodies to enhance community resilience requirements, closure and post mining land use engagements, and integrated environmental risk and management support etc.)

Technical Work

Work with the team to develop short-term inputs and/or consultancy assignments on topics such as environmental risk management, biodiversity, decarbonization, major hazards, tailings, waste, water, air quality, rehabilitation, regional economic development, climate finance and nature-based solutions
Lead technical input into the design, planning and delivery of environmental and socioeconomic impact initiatives driven by mining companies, including the development and implementation of environmental management plans and systems that also engage private sector, impact funders or development organizations to co-invest in positive impact
Contribute to research, analysis and publication of technical reports, case studies, policy/program approaches, and results summaries on themes related to environmental risk, community resilience, regional economic development, post mining land use, closure, rehabilitation, and social and just transition in emerging markets
Help to identify, build, and maintain relationships with partners and consultants that can provide environmental and technical expertise to Palladium-managed projects
Stay current on trends and tendencies in the mining sector and track structural, governance and ESG target changes for key clients, including evolving expectations on biodiversity, decarbonization, tailings, waste, water and closure
Work with others in the EGNC Portfolio to promote and build Palladium’s technical capability, especially regarding integrated environmental and socioeconomic work with mining companies

Essential Criteria

7+ years of senior-level experience in a client-facing management role on large, private/public sector projects, especially relating to mining industry, environmental management, closure, and/or ESG implementation with exposure to climate, nature-based solutions or regional economic development
5+ years working directly with mining companies as clients
Fluency in English and at least one other language, in either French, Spanish, or Portuguese
Masters in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Natural Resources, Economics, Anthropology, Sociology, Business Administration, International Development, Politics or related discipline preferred
Strong networks in the mining and minerals sector
Preference for experience managing teams across geographies and cultures
Proven experience in or on emerging market issues and/or contexts
Experience leading business development efforts
Strong environmental background, including understanding of environmental risks in the mining context and demonstrated experience leading the design and implementation of environmental management plans and/or managing biodiversity, decarbonization, major hazards, tailings, waste, water, air, and rehabilitation efforts
In-house experience working for a mining company preferred

Core Abilities Required

Strong ability to manage multiple simultaneous tasks and/or complex projects/assignments as demonstrated by experience to date
Excellent written and oral communication skills as demonstrated by speaking engagements and/or written documents produced
Financial acumen and the ability to generate and analyze financial reports and forecasts using Excel
Sound problem-solving and decision-making skills Demonstrated commitment to encourage diversity, inclusion, and equity in teams and programs
Experience implementing post mining land use programs and working in the closure and rehabilitation phase of the asset life cycle
Experience engaging multisector stakeholders in mining communities and regions
Proven ability to apply and adapt models and approaches to catalyzing enduring and inclusive environmental and socioeconomic outcomes in emerging markets
Experience with conceptualizing and writing technical proposals and reports for private sector clients as well as international donors, including both PowerPoint and
text documents
Experience with conceptualizing and delivering presentations to small and large groups both in-person and virtually

Manage & Mentor: Act as the direct people manager for a cohort of Emerging Talent AI Builders. Deliver regular 1:1s, performance reviews, career development planning, and compensation management.
Bridge the Gap: Help AI natives pivot from 'building experimental side projects' to deploying production-grade, secure, and ethical enterprise software, showing them how to scale their boundary-pushing ideas responsibly.
Consulting Coaching: Teach technical grads how to "translate tech into business value." Coach them on active listening, stakeholder management, discovery sessions, presentation skills, and handling pushback from customers.
Cultivating Belonging and Long-term Engagement: Establish a vibrant, inclusive atmosphere. Provide guidance through the specific challenges of early-career excellence, including managing rapid advancement paths, addressing imposter syndrome, and meeting the distinct professional needs of high-potential recent graduates.
Technical Leadership & Project Governance (30%)
Agentforce Guardrails: Guide graduates through the design of agentic reasoning, prompt engineering, and tool calls. Ensure they are evaluating AI outputs with strict engineering rigor rather than trial-and-error.
Technical Coaching: Support Graduates in building scalable and secure agentic solutions. Act as an internal technical sounding partner when a Graduate encounters roadblocks, ensuring they are equipped to succeed.
Graduate Builder Program Enablement & Strategy (30%)
Pioneer Continuous Upskilling: Foster an active, experimental lab culture where testing the absolute limits of generative AI and Agentforce is celebrated. You will use insights gained from your cohort's rapid experimentation to feed back into the broader organization's upskilling initiatives.
Project Matching & Bench Management: Oversee the pipeline of customer work, strategically pairing Grads with projects that stretch their technical capabilities while balancing business needs.
Development Milestones: Build, track, and optimize a 12-to-24-month competency matrix detailing when a Grad is expected to master specific technical tracks (e.g., Real-Time Infra) and consulting pillars.
University Recruiting Partner: Collaborate with the University Recruiting team to interview, assess, and attract top-tier Computer Science talent from target universities.

The Ideal Profile

You can speak their language...

You have a deep background in computer science or software engineering. You understand object-oriented programming, data structures, and the current landscape of LLMs/prompt engineering.

and you can teach them yours.

You are a seasoned consultant or customer-facing tech lead. You know how to read a room, handle a tough customer question during a live deployment, and unpack complex business requirements into technical user stories. Prior experience managing university graduate programs, technical rotation programs, or tech boot camps.
Direct experience with the Salesforce ecosystem, Apex, or building on Agentforce.
Background in Enterprise Agile delivery and technical scoping.

Why This Role is Unique

Unlike traditional engineering managers who operate strictly behind the scenes, or traditional consulting managers focused purely on utilization metrics, you are at the epicenter of a workforce revolution. You are not just teaching a syllabus, you are leading a generation of AI natives who will fundamentally rewrite how businesses operate. In this role, you have a blank canvas to push boundaries, experiment with leading-edge agentic technology, and serve as the premier showcase for Salesforce's company-wide up-skilling strategy. EXECUTIVE SEARCH: Vice President of Engineering

📍 Remote (U.S.), East Coast preferred; must overlap with Eastern Time hours
💼 Full-time | Reports to CEO | Executive leadership team
💰 Competitive salary and equity

THE COMPANY
Pittbos is an AI-forward software company serving the construction materials industry (asphalt, aggregates, concrete). Built by industry experts, our products help producer/supplier and paver organizations manage sales and operations with features including CRM, costing, pricing, forecasting and more.

Pittbos software is in production, with customers live at some of the largest producer and paving organizations in the country. Several enterprise onboardings are under way for January go-live. Demand currently exceeds engineering capacity. This position exists to close that gap.

POSITION OVERVIEW
The Vice President of Engineering will assume full ownership of the technical organization, inheriting a production platform, an established customer base, and a team that ships. It is a hands-on executive role: the successful candidate will set technical direction while remaining close to the codebase and to the customers who depend on it.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
▪️ Team Leadership: Lead the current engineering team, establish clear ownership and performance standards, and recruit as the organization grows. This role sets the hiring bar.
▪️ Delivery and Execution: Own the development lifecycle end to end, including release cadence and CI/CD on GitLab.
▪️ Architecture and Infrastructure: Own and scale a Go microservices architecture on AWS over PostgreSQL (Aurora), MongoDB, and Redis.
▪️ Artificial Intelligence: Pittbos is embedding AI across quoting, costing, and RFQ workflows, and is migrating its AI stack to Claude. This role owns the architecture of those capabilities.
▪️ Customer and Investor Engagement: Lead technical diligence, security review, and architecture discussions with enterprise buyers.

QUALIFICATIONS
✅ Demonstrated leadership of an engineering team, with accountability for its delivery
✅ Experience building and scaling SaaS platforms, with direct ownership of AWS and microservices architecture
✅ Backend depth, with Go preferred though not required
✅ Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and with AI-assisted development

FIRST-YEAR OBJECTIVES
Within twelve months, the company expects to have cleared enterprise security and architecture review at national accounts, delivered AI capabilities in daily customer use, and established a larger engineering team operating on a delivery cadence the sales organization can commit to.

The strongest candidates will want an environment small enough for individual decisions to reach production quickly, and customers close enough to hold the organization directly accountable.

TO APPLY
📩 Resumes and direct inquiries may be sent to recruiting@pittbos.com

added.title: Chief Technology Officer
added.description:
At Journal Technologies, we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society - the courts and justice system.

We create and implement enterprise software that supports the administration of justice, currently in the United States, Canada, and Australia. While our eSeries product suite enables governments and their employees to deliver continued foundational court processes, our R&D focuses on leveraging emerging possibilities with technology to improve access and efficiency.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Journal Technologies is a long-time, wholly-owned subsidiary of Daily Journal Corporation (NASDAQ: DJCO). We also have a major office in Logan, Utah, a team in Melbourne, Australia, an office in Victoria, Canada and a growing number of remote staff across North America.

Under our next generation of leadership, we're implementing a vision for the company that prioritizes building an extraordinary workplace with empowered people at the heart of our business. Great people want to collaborate with great people, and we are actively looking for smart, motivated people who care deeply about the work they do.

Chief Technology Officer

The Chief Technology Officer leads technology strategy, architecture, product development, and engineering across Journal Technologies. This leader sets and champions the technical vision, brings strong product and engineering thinking to every initiative, and ensures the company's platforms remain secure, reliable, and positioned for growth. The CTO works cross-functionally with every department and plays a central role in building out the new technology team described above, helping recruit talent and shape how new ideas are evaluated, developed, and scaled.

What You'll Do

Develop and lead a multi-year technology vision and roadmap aligned with the long-term goals of Journal Technologies and drive it across the organization.
Bring a customer-centric, problem-first approach to product development, ensuring teams deeply understand user needs before committing to solutions.
Identify emerging technologies and market opportunities that strengthen existing products and open new areas of value for the company.
Advise executive leadership on technology investments, build-versus-buy decisions, and potential acquisitions or partnerships.
Define architectural vision and principles, ensuring systems are configurable, repeatable, scalable, secure, appropriately modular, and engineered to upgrade and evolve over time.
Apply platform thinking by promoting reusable services, APIs, and shared components that serve multiple products and business units.
Own the modernization of the Company's technology portfolio, balancing investment in existing platforms with technical debt, modernization, consolidation, and next-generation capabilities.
Lead the engineering organization with a culture grounded in ownership, craftsmanship, continuous improvement, and pragmatic decision-making.
Maintain and advance modern engineering practices, balancing speed of delivery with quality, reliability, and security.
Support our organization-wide transition to Agile methodologies and Scrum-at-Scale.
Serve as a true partner to other departments, building alignment on priorities, timelines, and resources across the organization.
Translate complex technical concepts into clear business terms for non-technical stakeholders, and bring business context back to technical teams.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology organization, including organizational design, leadership development, succession planning, workforce strategy, and recruitment of critical technical capabilities needed for the Company's future.
Ensure appropriate standards for security, privacy, compliance, and data governance, including requirements common to courts, government agencies, and criminal justice systems (such as CJIS).
Oversee technology investment, performance, and operational resilience, ensuring resources are aligned with priorities and systems remain reliable, scalable, and prepared for business continuity.
Establish effective technology governance and risk management, partnering with Security, Cloud Operations, IT, Legal, and business leaders to manage architectural, cybersecurity, regulatory, and third-party technology risks.

Qualifications & Skills

12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in senior technical leadership roles (CTO, VP of Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar).
Proven experience leading and scaling engineering organizations and enterprise software platforms.
Deep expertise in software and systems architecture, including distributed systems, cloud-native design, APIs, and data platforms.
Strong product sense, with experience making customer-driven product decisions.
A track record of setting a compelling technical vision and rallying teams and executives around it.
Proven success working cross-functionally, with excellent communication skills and the ability to engage executives, engineers, customers, and partners alike.
Background in government technology, justice or court systems, legal technology, or other regulated public sector markets is highly desirable.
Experience incubating new products or working in a startup, innovation lab, or venture environment is preferred.
Hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, and data-driven technologies to real products is preferred.
Experience working within Agile teams or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
Given the highly collaborative nature of this role, preference will be shown for candidates able to work on a regular/hybrid basis from our Los Angeles headquarters.

Description

The American Public Works Association
(APWA) is looking for an experienced and forward-thinking Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the organization's technology strategy and help shape how we use technology to serve our members, staff, and the public works profession.

As a member of the executive leadership team, the CTO will work closely with leaders across the organization to ensure our technology investments support APWA's strategic goals, enhance the member experience, and position us for the future. This role provides leadership for enterprise systems, cybersecurity, data governance, digital transformation, artificial intelligence readiness, and technology operations.

The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with practical execution. They are just as comfortable discussing long-term technology strategy with executive leadership as they are guiding projects, supporting teams, and ensuring day-to-day technology operations run smoothly.

What You'll Do

Develop and lead APWA's technology strategy and roadmap, ensuring technology initiatives align with organizational priorities and long-term goals.
Partner with executive leadership to evaluate technology investments, establish priorities, and drive digital transformation across the organization.
Oversee enterprise systems, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, business continuity planning, and technology risk management.
Help the organization strengthen its use of data, reporting, analytics, and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.
Lead and develop the internal technology team while managing relationships with technology vendors, consultants, and strategic partners.
Ensure technology projects are effectively planned, communicated, and delivered with measurable results.
Oversee technology budgeting, contracts, licensing, and resource planning.
Serve as the organization's technology leader during significant technology disruptions or cybersecurity incidents.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
At least 10 years of progressively responsible technology leadership experience.
Demonstrated success leading technology strategy, enterprise systems, cybersecurity, data initiatives, cloud technologies, and organizational change.
Experience managing staff, vendors, consultants, and third-party technology partners.
Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to translate complex technology concepts into business value.
Experience in an association, nonprofit, membership organization, or similar environment is a plus. Experience with Salesforce/Fonteva is also desirable.

Why APWA?

APWA is proud to be a people-centric workplace, with a key focus on flexibility and work-life balance. We offer remote-hybrid work schedules, 15 days each of paid vacation and family medical leave, 11 paid holidays and the opportunity to have a flexible schedule with alternate Fridays off. We also offer excellent and affordable insurance coverage as well as matching retirement contributions. APWA invests in ongoing growth through employee professional and continuing education opportunities.

We’re proud of the work we do because our work matters. Every role at APWA contributes to advancing the quality of life for others as we support those who operate, improve, and maintain public works and infrastructure. As we serve over 30,000 members (and counting!) across North America, we’re always looking for motivated and inspiring people to join us.

Starting salary $175,000+, DOE

About SSI

SS Industries is a Collegeville, PA-based manufacturer of premium Spiral and Floating Stairs. Stairs are designed and manufactured in-house using steel, aluminum, and wood, and shipped directly to customers across the U.S. and Canada. SSI is part of the MBP Group, a family of home-building products companies.

Position Summary

The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day engineering and manufacturing responsibilities at SSI. This person owns product design/execution, safety, quality, efficiency, on-time delivery, and cost. They build a strong team, keep production running smoothly through busy seasons, and drive continuous improvement.

In addition, the Director of Operations works with the SSI Leadership Team to develop and implement key company strategic efforts. They work cross-functionally with the other directors to ensure strong business performance.

Key Responsibilities

Lead a strong safety culture where associates look out for each other and return to their homes safely.
Own OSHA compliance, safety training, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
Work with the Production Manager to ensure maximized capacity, labor, fabrication, welding, and powder coating to achieve communicated lead times, especially during peak seasons.
Drive the Quality Team to reduce defects, rework, and customer complaints through root cause problem solving.
Work with Customer Service and Engineering to resolve product issues quickly.
Identify and lead projects that reduce waste and cost.
Partner with the Purchasing Team to maintain appropriate inventory levels on raw materials like steel, aluminum, and wood to support production levels.
Build and manage the Operations Annual Operating Plan and budget.
Control labor, overtime, materials, and maintenance costs.
Identify, recommend, and justify capital investments.
Work closely with the President, Finance and the Commercial teams on forecasts, priorities, and customer commitments.
Partner with Engineering and Marketing on the development and execution of new products and custom orders.
Work closely with external vendors and partners to ensure consistent progress.
Share best practices with operations leaders across the MBP Group.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
10+ years in operations, with experience leading several departments, such as engineering, quality, production, or supply chain.
8+ years of manufacturing experience, with at least 5 years leading plant teams.
Experience in metal fabrication, welding, or building products manufacturing.
Strong track record improving safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
Hands-on experience with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement.
Proven ability to lead and develop supervisors and hourly teams, alike.
Comfortable developing, reporting, presenting, and leading with data, KPIs, and budgets.
Strong communication skills at every level of the organization (both internal and external).
Can scale operations as the company grows.
Onsite presence in Collegeville, PA

Experience with engineer-to-order fabrication (architectural metals, stairs and railings, millwork, structural steel or similar) and/or direct-to-consumer manufacturing.
Has run a P&L or departmental budget and capital projects and has managed through supervisors and managers.
Experience in a private equity-backed or multi-site company.
Lean manufacturing experience (5S, value-stream mapping, kaizen). Lean or Six Sigma certification.
Hands-on approach and comfortability on the shop floor.
ERP or MRP system experience.

added.title: Vice President of CE&I (Mission Critical Infrastructure)
added.description:
Position Scope

The Vice President of CE&I will provide strategic and operational leadership for PACK Power's CE&I Division, overseeing the successful execution, growth, and profitability of the business.
This individual will be responsible for developing the people, processes, client relationships, and operational strategies necessary to scale the CE&I group while maintaining PACK Power's commitment to safety, quality, schedule, financial performance, and customer satisfaction.
The VP will work closely with executive leadership, project management, estimating, preconstruction, field operations, safety, finance, and business development to ensure the CE&I Division is positioned for sustainable growth and consistently delivers successful projects.
This is a highly visible leadership role for an individual who can operate strategically while remaining connected to the field and the people executing the work
Location Details:
This position can be located at or near any of our office locations: Denver, Colorado or Fargo, North Dakkota. This position will travel as needed to regional offices or site locations.
Company Overview 

PACK Power was founded in 2023 to meet a growing demand for specialized High Voltage and Medium Voltage expertise within the Renewable, Power Delivery, Utility, and Data Center markets. The company was built by industry veterans, bringing decades of hands-on experience and a shared vision of partnering with clients to deliver exceptional, successful projects. Our suite of specialized services spans substations, transmission lines, switchyards, and collection systems, delivering innovative solutions that power the future while prioritizing sustainability and reliability.   

At its core, PACK Power is built on people. We operate like a family, with a culture rooted in teamwork, trust, and looking out for one another. Our “us over me” mindset creates a respectful, collaborative, and high-performing environment where individuals can grow and succeed together. Honesty, responsiveness, and clear communication guide on how we work — with each other and with our clients. Like a pack of wolves, every team member plays a vital role, united by shared purpose as we lead the High Voltage and Medium Voltage industries.  

Our CE&I Division delivers integrated controls, electrical, and instrumentation solutions for industrial and mission-critical infrastructure projects. From utility interconnects through final terminations, our CE&I Division supports data centers, water and wastewater treatment facilities, natural gas facilities, and industrial process environments with safe, reliable, and execution-focused delivery. 

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

Develop and execute the overall strategic direction and growth plan for the CE&I Division.
Identify new markets, customers, project opportunities, and strategic partnerships that align with PACK Power's capabilities.
Establish annual and long-term business objectives for revenue, profitability, backlog, utilization, and market growth.
Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of future CE&I opportunities in partnership with Business Development and Estimating.
Evaluate market trends and emerging opportunities within data centers, industrial facilities, natural gas, water/wastewater, utility infrastructure, and other mission-critical markets.
Participate in executive-level planning, forecasting, and company-wide strategic initiatives.
Provide oversight and direction for CE&I project execution from preconstruction through commissioning and turnover.
Establish operational standards, processes, and best practices that improve project execution and consistency.

This is an internal facing role which will shape the technology that enables a global organisation to do its best work. As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering, you’ll lead the team responsible for Diligent’s Atlassian and Microsoft platforms while setting the architectural direction for the wider internal IT estate.
You’ll combine people leadership, enterprise platform strategy and hands-on technical judgement to create secure, reliable and scalable experiences for employees worldwide. From modernising service management and automating joiner, mover and leaver processes to enabling AI safely through Microsoft Copilot and Atlassian Rovo, your work will reduce friction, strengthen governance and deliver measurable business impact.
Working across IT, Security, HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance and business teams, you’ll turn complex requirements into well-governed platforms that are easy to use, resilient and ready for the future.
Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff)
Lead, coach and grow a global team of platform engineers and systems administrators, building a high-performing and inclusive culture.
Own the strategy, architecture, governance and roadmap for Atlassian Cloud, including Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Atlassian Guard and Rovo.
Set the direction for Diligent’s Microsoft 365 E5 estate, including Teams, SharePoint, Exchange Online, Intune, Defender, Purview, Power Platform and Copilot.
Design scalable integration and automation patterns across identity, HRIS, ITSM and business systems using APIs, event-driven automation, Okta Workflows, Power Platform and scripting.
Partner with IT Support to improve self-service, automate repetitive work and reduce ticket volume, escalation effort and time to resolution.
Establish strong standards for security, access governance, AI adoption, reliability, compliance and business continuity across the internal technology estate.

These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview
Significant experience in internal IT, platform engineering, enterprise applications or a similar environment, including experience leading technical teams in a distributed organisation.
Deep hands-on experience owning Atlassian Cloud at enterprise scale, particularly Jira, Jira Service Management and Confluence.

The ability to set architecture direction across identity and cloud technologies, with practical knowledge of Okta or an equivalent SSO platform, Active Directory, Entra ID and AWS.
Proven success applying ITIL-aligned service management, automation and self-service to improve employee support outcomes.
Strong understanding of identity and access governance, least privilege, data loss prevention, IT general controls and audit requirements.
A track record of developing engineers, influencing cross-functional partners and communicating technical decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

It would be great if you had these too, but we’ll support you if you don’t
Experience deploying Microsoft Copilot and/or Atlassian Rovo, with a focus on permissions, responsible adoption and measurable business value.
Experience with platform automation or infrastructure-as-code using tools such as PowerShell, Python, Terraform or CloudFormation.
Experience with enterprise platform migrations, HRIS-driven provisioning, managed service providers or regulated environments such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or FedRAMP.

added.title: VP, Business Technology Strategy & Integration
added.description:
EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.

We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.

We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. 

Job Description

WHAT DOES A VP, BUSINESS TECHNOLOGY STRATEGY & INTEGRATION DO?

The VP, Business Technology Strategy & Integration is a critical leadership role responsible for the strategic oversight, governance, and orchestration of business technology initiatives across a key client account.

Serving as the accountable leader for business technology strategy and execution, this role provides vision, solution leadership, and cross-functional oversight—aligning business priorities, technology capabilities, data integrations, and delivery teams to drive informed, proactive decision-making, reduce organizational friction, and enable scalable execution. Positioned directly within the Agency team, this role ensures seamless integration with brand and experience strategy, and client service, while maintaining a strong governance bridge to EVERSANA’s broader Technology, Enterprise Data, and Solutions Delivery teams.

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

Technology Strategy & Business Integration Leadership

Lead Business Technology Strategy: Serve as the strategic leader responsible for aligning commercial business objectives, agency strategy, and overall technology direction in collaboration with client lead. Translate brand and commercial priorities into clear technology strategies, capability plans, investment recommendations, and long-term maturity roadmaps that enable scalable business outcomes.
Shape the Technology Vision: Provide visionary leadership for the evolution of business technology capabilities across the portfolio. Anticipate future business needs, emerging platforms, and healthcare industry trends to proactively guide capability investments and digital innovation.
Own Strategic Technology Oversight: Maintain enterprise-level visibility across technology capabilities, integration strategies, platform dependencies, constraints, and roadmaps. Provide governance and executive oversight to proactively identify strategic risks, technical friction, and capability gaps.
Drive Executive Alignment: Partner closely with client leadership (e.g., client commercial/marketing stakeholders) and agency leads to maintain and evolve a unified technology strategy aligned with omnichannel and business goals.

Strategic Leadership & Technology Governance

Translate Strategy into Technology Direction: Serve as the primary strategic bridge between business objectives and technical execution, defining the vision, guiding principles, and functional direction that enable delivery teams to succeed.
Lead Solution Strategy: Provide consultative leadership on marketing technology approaches, validating business needs against enterprise platform capabilities (e.g., SFMC, Salesforce Sales/Service Cloud, OneTrust, Veeva, Web/CMS, CDP/Data Cloud).
Guide Enterprise Integration: Establish and oversee business technology and data integration strategies to ensure connected, scalable, and compliant solutions across brand touchpoints (HCP and Patient).
Govern Technology Decisions: Oversee technology planning, identify cross-functional dependencies early, and ensure proposed solution architectures align with enterprise standards, compliance regulations, and future-state capability roadmaps.

Business Technology Leadership & Enablement

Own the Business Technology Roadmap: Partner with EVERSANA Intouch leadership and client marketing leads to prioritize and evolve the business maturity roadmap, ensuring investments address both immediate tactical needs and long-term capability growth.
Serve as the Technology Authority: Act as the organization’s trusted advisor and authoritative voice on technology capabilities, platform constraints, integration feasibility, and digital activation opportunities.
Enable Informed Decision-Making: Guide business leaders, account teams, and client stakeholders on implementation implications, resource trade-offs, and technical considerations to improve planning and budget allocations.
Drive Cross-Functional Synergy: Facilitate executive decision-making across multidisciplinary teams—including Account, PMO, Experience Strategy (XS), Media, Analytics, Creative, and Technology Delivery.

Execution Oversight & Operational Excellence

Provide Execution Oversight: Maintain strategic oversight throughout project lifecycles to ensure technical implementations remain strictly aligned with approved solution designs, business goals, and quality standards.
Own Operational Governance: Establish and continuously evolve governance frameworks, operating models (including agency), and quality standards that drive consistency, accountability, and scalability across all digital initiatives.
Lead Operational Readiness: Own the strategy and governance for operational documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), implementation playbooks, rollout frameworks, and governance charters.
Drive Continuous Improvement: Champion ongoing optimization of technology operating models and cross-functional ways of working to reduce organizational friction, improve delivery velocity, and strengthen technical execution.
Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

Perform all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience in technology strategy, martech consulting, enterprise digital transformation, or digital agency leadership within the Life Sciences / Healthcare & Pharmaceutical industry.
Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of commercial pharmaceutical marketing, omnichannel engagement strategies (HCP & Patient), digital operating models, and agency cross-functional workflows.
Platform Knowledge: Robust knowledge of enterprise marketing tech ecosystems, including deep knowledge in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), Salesforce Data Cloud, Veeva systems, OneTrust privacy governance, Web/CMS platforms, and Analytics/Data integration frameworks.
Strategic Acumen: Proven track record translating complex business requirements into actionable technology strategies, multi-year maturity roadmaps, and execution governance.
Leadership & Influence: Outstanding executive presence with demonstrated ability to establish trust with VP/senior client stakeholders and bridge communication between non-technical business leads and technical developers/architects.
Operational Excellence: Experience building Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), governance frameworks, and cross-agency RACI models.
Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and workshop facilitation skills.

Additional Information

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded
I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight
I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action
I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent
I own my development and invest in the development of others. 

Win Together
I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters
I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity
I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate
 I am bold and creative in everything I do.

added.title: Director AI Engineering (Remote Eligible)
added.description:
At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The Generative AI Training team builds the platform Capital One's scientists and engineers use to train, fine-tune, and experiment with foundation models at scale. We run the GPU clusters and distributed training infrastructure behind the company's generative AI: fair-share scheduling across teams, large-scale fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, resilience for long-running jobs, and the utilization controls that keep that expensive hardware working efficiently. We also provide the self-service environments where teams deploy, serve, and evaluate models during experimentation, built on tools like KServe and vLLM. The platform we build is a central leverage point for AI across Capital One, shaping how fast and how affordable the rest of the company can build with foundation models.

What You’ll Do:

Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and operation of the platform's core systems: distributed training and fine-tuning, reinforcement learning workflows, fair-share GPU scheduling, job resilience and fault tolerance, GPU utilization and efficiency, and self-service environments for model experimentation and evaluation.
Make high judgment build-vs-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more.
Invent and introduce state-of-the-art techniques to improve the scalability, cost, throughput, and reliability of large-scale distributed training and fine-tuning.
Own GPU capacity planning and cost governance: right-size clusters, instance types, and quotas to the needs of training and experimentation workloads across teams.
Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state-of-the-art in AI.
Translate the enterprise AI strategy into portfolio-level execution plans across multiple product areas, balancing innovation with delivery discipline
Scale AI engineering practices across teams through shared infrastructure, reusable components, and unified observability and governance frameworks
Establish enterprise standard for Responsible AI, including fairness metrics, model evaluation protocols, documentation requirements, and audit readiness
Partner with research, compliance, and enterprise risk teams to ensure deployed systems meet emerging ethical and regulatory standards

The Ideal Candidate:

You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands-on when necessary and lead by example
You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven
You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss
You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 8 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
At least 3 years of people leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications:

5+ years of experience managing and leading an engineering team
7+ years of experience building and operating large-scale ML or GPU training infrastructure on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
Hands-on experience with distributed training at scale: multi-node, multi-GPU jobs and parallelism strategies (e.g., PyTorch FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron), with proficiency in Python, Go, C++, or CUDA
Experience with the ML orchestration and scheduling stack (e.g., Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Kueue, Slurm, Ray, KServe, vLLM)
Experience operating large GPU fleets with a focus on reliability, fault tolerance, utilization, and cost efficiency
Experience right-sizing GPU clusters, instance types, interconnect, and quotas to training and experimentation workload requirements (e.g., model size, parallelism strategy, throughput targets)
Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI and ML-systems research, and judiciously applying novel training and optimization techniques
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI and infrastructure concepts to peers
Experience building and leading a multi-team AI organization delivering multiple enterprise capabilities concurrently
Proven ability to expand and execute long-term AI platform strategies aligned to enterprise priorities and regulatory frameworks
Experience establishing cross-functional operating rhythms and review cadences (OKRs, AI governance councils, quarterly reviews)

Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

added.description:
Location: United States - Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary Range: $180,000 per year + Equity + Annual Bonus Negotiable

Role Summary:
We are Hiring this role for our client based in USA and Looking for The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will lead our overall technology strategy,SaaS infrastructure, product development, and cybersecurity. This role will work directly with the CEO and executive team to align technology with business goals and scale our engineering organization.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technology Strategy & Leadership
Define and own the long-term technology roadmap aligned with business goals.
Evaluate and make build vs. buy decisions for core platform components.
Act as the technical face of the company for enterprise clients, partners, and investors.
Own technology budgeting, vendor selection, and cost optimization (FinOps).

2. SaaS Architecture & Infrastructure
Architect and scale a secure, multi-tenant SaaS platform for high availability (99.99%+), performance, and global low-latency.
Lead our cloud-native infrastructure (AWS / GCP / Azure) - Kubernetes, microservices, event-driven architecture, API gateway.
Own infrastructure as code (Terraform), CI/CD, observability, and SRE practices.
Drive scalability planning to support 10x - 100x growth in users, data, and transactions.

3. Engineering Management
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing engineering team (Backend, Frontend, DevOps, QA, SRE).
Implement best practices for agile development, code reviews, testing, documentation, and release management.
Foster a culture of engineering excellence, ownership, and innovation.

4. Security, Compliance & Reliability
Own InfoSec, data privacy, and compliance - SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR.
Implement DevSecOps, zero-trust architecture, secrets management, encryption, and vulnerability management.
Lead incident response, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity planning (BCP).
Ensure platform reliability through robust monitoring, logging, and alerting (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus/Grafana).

5. Product & Innovation
Partner closely with Product and CEO to translate product vision into scalable technical execution.
Drive platform extensibility via public APIs, webhooks, integrations, and marketplace.
Stay ahead of trends in AI/ML infrastructure, data pipelines, and SaaS platform engineering.

10+ years in engineering, with 4+ years as a CTO, VP of Engineering, or Head of Infrastructure in a B2B SaaS company.
Proven track record scaling a SaaS platform from early stage to $10M+ ARR / millions of users.
Expert-level knowledge of cloud infrastructure: AWS (preferred), Kubernetes, Docker, Microservices.
Strong expertise in: Distributed systems, Multi-tenant architecture, PostgreSQL / NoSQL, Redis, Kafka / RabbitMQ, REST & GraphQL.
Deep experience with DevOps/SRE: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), Terraform, Observability, SRE principles.
Strong background in SaaS security, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data protection.
Experience leading teams of 15-50+ engineers across multiple geographies.
Hands-on coder - you can still review architecture, debug production issues, and write code when needed.

Nice to Have:
Experience with usage-based billing, metering, and multi-region SaaS deployments.
Experience with data infrastructure - Data Lake, ETL/ELT, Snowflake/BigQuery.
Experience fundraising or working directly with a board.
Previous experience in FinTech, AI SaaS, or DevTools.

What We Offer:
Remote work with US overlap
Health, Dental, Vision benefits
Leadership opportunity to build and scale

We run the GPU clusters and distributed training infrastructure behind the company's generative AI: fair-share scheduling across teams, large-scale fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, resilience for long-running jobs, and the utilization controls that keep that expensive hardware working efficiently. We also provide the self-service environments where teams deploy, serve, and evaluate models during experimentation, built on tools like KServe and vLLM. The platform we build is a central leverage point for AI across Capital One, shaping how fast and how affordable the rest of the company can build with foundation models.

What You’ll Do:

Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and operation of the platform's core systems: distributed training and fine-tuning, reinforcement learning workflows, fair-share GPU scheduling, job resilience and fault tolerance, GPU utilization and efficiency, and self-service environments for model experimentation and evaluation.
Make high judgment build-vs-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more.
Invent and introduce state-of-the-art techniques to improve the scalability, cost, throughput, and reliability of large-scale distributed training and fine-tuning.
Own GPU capacity planning and cost governance: right-size clusters, instance types, and quotas to the needs of training and experimentation workloads across teams.
Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state-of-the-art in AI.
Translate the enterprise AI strategy into portfolio-level execution plans across multiple product areas, balancing innovation with delivery discipline
Scale AI engineering practices across teams through shared infrastructure, reusable components, and unified observability and governance frameworks
Establish enterprise standard for Responsible AI, including fairness metrics, model evaluation protocols, documentation requirements, and audit readiness
Partner with research, compliance, and enterprise risk teams to ensure deployed systems meet emerging ethical and regulatory standards

The Ideal Candidate:

You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands-on when necessary and lead by example
You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven
You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss
You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 8 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
At least 3 years of people leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications:

5+ years of experience managing and leading an engineering team
7+ years of experience building and operating large-scale ML or GPU training infrastructure on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
Hands-on experience with distributed training at scale: multi-node, multi-GPU jobs and parallelism strategies (e.g., PyTorch FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron), with proficiency in Python, Go, C++, or CUDA
Experience with the ML orchestration and scheduling stack (e.g., Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Kueue, Slurm, Ray, KServe, vLLM)
Experience operating large GPU fleets with a focus on reliability, fault tolerance, utilization, and cost efficiency
Experience right-sizing GPU clusters, instance types, interconnect, and quotas to training and experimentation workload requirements (e.g., model size, parallelism strategy, throughput targets)
Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI and ML-systems research, and judiciously applying novel training and optimization techniques
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI and infrastructure concepts to peers
Experience building and leading a multi-team AI organization delivering multiple enterprise capabilities concurrently
Proven ability to expand and execute long-term AI platform strategies aligned to enterprise priorities and regulatory frameworks
Experience establishing cross-functional operating rhythms and review cadences (OKRs, AI governance councils, quarterly reviews)

Environmental Conditions

Office

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Discover Impactful Work

The Senior Manager, Application Science - Software Workflow and Strategy, leads a team that represents the scientific voice of the customer across the Genetic Sciences Division software portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of genetics, AI, laboratory workflows, and software development, translating customer needs and scientific use cases into actionable guidance for software teams.

This leader brings deep domain expertise in genetics or proteomics workflows, strong fluency in scientific software development, and the ability to work effectively across Product Management, UX, Software Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams. This is not a hands-on software development role; rather, it requires someone who can translate scientific and workflow needs into actionable guidance for software teams. A critical part of the role is helping define how AI, automation, and evolving lab-in-the-loop workflows can make genetic and proteomic scientists more effective by simplifying workflows, supporting interpretation, and reducing manual effort. The successful candidate will connect strategy to execution, helping shape future direction while ensuring teams can act on it effectively.

Location

This is a fully onsite role based at our South San Francisco, CA office. Carlsbad, CA and Pleasanton, CA may also be considered as alternative work locations. Relocation assistance is not provided for this position.

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

Lead and develop a high-performing team that represents customer scientific workflows across the GSD software development lifecycle.
Provide domain leadership in genetics and proteomic workflows to ensure software solutions align with real laboratory needs.

Strategy and Workflow Direction

Partner with Product Management to provide scientific and workflow input into software strategy, roadmap planning, and long-range priorities.
Help define future-state laboratory workflows, including how AI and automation can improve the experience of genetic scientists, and translate that vision into actionable guidance for software teams.

Customer and Workflow Translation

Engage with customers, key opinion leaders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow pain points, unmet needs, and emerging expectations.
Translate scientific and workflow insights into clear use cases, requirements guidance, and development inputs for software teams.

Cross-Functional and Team Leadership

Work effectively across Product Management, UX, Software Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to guide scientifically grounded software decisions in a matrixed environment.
Lead through influence while building team capability, driving strong execution, and connecting strategic priorities to day-to-day action.

Keys to Success

Education

Advanced degrees in Genetics, Proteomics, Genomics, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field, with significant experience in genetics or genomics, including hands-on understanding of laboratory workflows, downstream analysis, and biological interpretation.

Experience

Demonstrated interest in and practical understanding of how AI can improve scientific software and laboratory workflows.
Proven ability to think strategically and contribute to future workflow and software direction, not just tactical execution.
Demonstrated ability to lead people and influence cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment, including effective partnership across Product Management, UX, Software Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams.

Preferred

Familiarity with responsible AI, workflow automation, and decision-support concepts in regulated environments.
Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory environments, including FDA, ISO 13485, IVDR, or forensic accreditation standards, where applicable.

Leadership Profile

Ability to connect strategy to roadmap and drive successful execution
Demonstrated leadership in a matrixed environment
Ability to lead and develop high-performing teams
Strong judgment and comfort operating in ambiguity
Innovation mindset balanced with scientific rigor and customer trust

Travel

Approximately 20-30%, including customer visits, internal meetings, workshops, conferences, and cross-site collaboration.

Other

Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check and drug screen.
