added.description:
About Palladium

Operating in over 50 countries, Palladium is a global consulting and implementation company working in partnership with governments, businesses, investors, and communities to design and deliver solutions that create lasting positive impact. We address some of the world’s most complex challenges across infrastructure, economic growth and natural capital, health, energy, climate and environment, and digital transformation—strengthening systems, institutions, and markets to support inclusive and sustainable development. Our more than 2,100 staff worldwide work as trusted advisors across diverse contexts, combining deep technical expertise, implementation techniques, and innovative technology to deliver locally informed, client-focused solutions that help organizations achieve measurable, sustainable impact.

Palladium is part of GISI’s global family of companies, which aims to create solutions for the world’s most complex challenges. With annual revenues of $14 billion, GISI’s approximately 15,000 employees are engaged in projects across 100 countries worldwide providing construction, program/project management, and engineering consulting services.

This Opportunity

The Sustainable Infrastructure team, part of the broader Economic Growth & Natural Capital (EGNC) Portfolio, partners with mining companies to design and implement positive impact programs—such as workforce skilling, reforestation, and sustainable agriculture—that benefit mining communities and regions. The team works across the entire mining life cycle, helping clients achieve ESG targets while building the foundation for community resilience beyond mine closure. The team draws on expertise from the wider EGNC portfolio, which also works with private sector clients as well as philanthropic bodies and diverse donors (IDB, USDA, AFD, WB) to support agricultural value chain development, enhance women’s access to finance, and mobilize capital for climate-positive initiatives. Overall, the business seeks to unlock and scale innovative solutions that drive inclusive growth and deliver sustainable value for communities

Palladium is seeking a Senior Manager, Sustainable Infrastructure - Oil & Gas
to bring team management experience and technical acumen to both business development and project delivery. The role will focus on oil and gas sector clients across the value chain, including upstream, midstream and downstream operations, as well as associated infrastructure such as pipelines, LNG terminals, shipping and logistics, storage, and refining assets. Competitive candidates should demonstrate experience working with these types of assets on ESG strategy, impact program design, and implementation, including workforce development, local content, economic diversification, community investment, and integration of ESG considerations into operational contexts. The Senior Manager will also contribute to business development efforts, including strategic planning, portfolio forecasting, proposal development, partnering, networking and recruitment. Fluency in English and one other additional language – French (preferred), Spanish, Arabic, or Portuguese is required.

Location and Compensation:

The position can be based out of Palladium’s Arlington, VA office
or remote in the United States (only some states may be considered)
. Applicants must have current/future work authorization in the US as visa sponsorship cannot be provided.

The annual base salary for this position is expected to range from $120,000 to $140,000
. Please be advised that a final salary offer will be based on various factors, including but not limited to your qualifications, education, experience, skills, seniority, performance, and Palladium’s business or organizational needs.

This role is also posted in the UK; however, there is only one available position.

Reporting Lines

This role reports to the Director, Sustainable Infrastructure (UK based)

Primary Roles And Responsibilities

Project Management

Lead multidisciplinary project teams to deliver high-quality, client-focused results across complex assignments
Oversee proposal development, budgeting, project planning, implementation, and reporting to ensure timely and effective delivery
Identify, engage, and manage partners and subcontractors to strengthen technical quality and delivery capacity
Manage partner and subcontractor performance to ensure contractually compliant delivery of agreed inputs, outputs, and outcomes
Serve as Project Director, providing quality assurance for deliverables and oversight of budgets, client relationships, and overall project performance

Business Development

Contribute to the identification, assessment, and pursuit of new business opportunities with a focus on expanding Palladium’s engagement with oil and gas companies and operators of associated infrastructure (pipelines, LNG terminals, shipping/logistics, storage and refining)
Contribute to the preparation of technical proposals principally targeting private sector and blended finance opportunities with oil and gas clients (focus on ESG strategy, impact program design and implementation, local content, economic diversification and regional development initiatives linked to energy infrastructure)

Technical Work

Work with the team to develop short-term inputs and/or consultancy assignments on topics such as economic development, local content, workforce development, ESG strategy and inclusive business models in oil and gas and related infrastructure contexts
Lead technical input into the design, planning and delivery of ESG and impact initiatives driven by oil and gas operators and infrastructure developers, including pipelines, LNG terminals, shipping/logistics corridors and refining operations that engage private sector, impact funders or development organizations to co-invest in positive impact
Contribute to research, analysis and publication of technical reports, case studies, policy/program approaches, and results summaries on themes related to ESG performance in the energy sector, community resilience, regional economic development and transition in oil and gas dependent regions
Help to identify, build, and maintain relationships with partners and consultants that can provide technical expertise to Palladium-managed projects Stay current on trends and tendencies in the oil and gas sector and track structural, governance and ESG target changes for key clients across upstream, midstream, downstream and infrastructure segments
Work with others in the EGNC Portfolio to promote and build Palladium’s technical capability, especially regarding work with mining companies

Essential Criteria

7+ years of senior-level experience in a client-facing management role on large, private/public sector projects, especially relating to oil and gas and/or associated infrastructure (pipelines, LNG terminals, shipping, storage and refining) with exposure to ESG, economic development or impact programming
5+ years working directly with oil and gas companies, operators or infrastructure developers as clients
Fluency in English and at least another language, in either French (preferred), Spanish, Arabic, or Portuguese
Strong networks in the oil and gas and broader energy infrastructure sector
Preference for experience managing teams across geographies and cultures
Proven experience in or on emerging market issues and/or contexts
Experience leading business development efforts and ability to leverage their own network activating new client portfolios quickly

Core Abilities Required

Strong ability to manage multiple simultaneous tasks and/or complex projects/assignments as demonstrated by experience to date
Excellent written and oral communication skills as demonstrated by speaking engagements and/or written documents produced
Financial acumen and the ability to generate and analyze financial reports and forecasts using Excel
Sound problem-solving and decision-making skills
Demonstrated commitment to encourage diversity, inclusion, and equity in teams and programs

Desirable Criteria

Masters in Economics, Social Sciences, Business Administration, International Development, Political Science, or related fields
Experience engaging multisector stakeholders in oil & gas and related infrastructure communities and regions
Proven ability to apply and adapt models and approaches to catalyzing enduring and inclusive economic growth in emerging markets
Experience with conceptualizing and writing technical proposals and reports for private sector clients as well as international donors, including both PowerPoint and text documents
Experience with conceptualizing and delivering presentations to small and large groups both in-person and virtually

Should you require any adjustments or accommodations to be made due to a disability or you are a neurodivergent individual, or for any other circumstance, please email our team at accessibility@thepalladiumgroup.com and we will be in touch to discuss.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Discover Impactful Work

The Senior Manager, Application Science - Software Workflow and Strategy, leads a team that represents the scientific voice of the customer across the Genetic Sciences Division software portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of genetics, AI, laboratory workflows, and software development, translating customer needs and scientific use cases into actionable guidance for software teams.

This leader brings deep domain expertise in genetics or proteomics workflows, strong fluency in scientific software development, and the ability to work effectively across Product Management, UX, Software Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams. This is not a hands-on software development role; rather, it requires someone who can translate scientific and workflow needs into actionable guidance for software teams. A critical part of the role is helping define how AI, automation, and evolving lab-in-the-loop workflows can make genetic and proteomic scientists more effective by simplifying workflows, supporting interpretation, and reducing manual effort. The successful candidate will connect strategy to execution, helping shape future direction while ensuring teams can act on it effectively.

Location

This is a fully onsite role based at our South San Francisco, CA office. Carlsbad, CA and Pleasanton, CA may also be considered as alternative work locations. Relocation assistance is not provided for this position.

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

Lead and develop a high-performing team that represents customer scientific workflows across the GSD software development lifecycle.
Provide domain leadership in genetics and proteomic workflows to ensure software solutions align with real laboratory needs.

Strategy and Workflow Direction

Partner with Product Management to provide scientific and workflow input into software strategy, roadmap planning, and long-range priorities.
Help define future-state laboratory workflows, including how AI and automation can improve the experience of genetic scientists, and translate that vision into actionable guidance for software teams.

Customer and Workflow Translation

Engage with customers, key opinion leaders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow pain points, unmet needs, and emerging expectations.
Translate scientific and workflow insights into clear use cases, requirements guidance, and development inputs for software teams.

Cross-Functional and Team Leadership

Work effectively across Product Management, UX, Software Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to guide scientifically grounded software decisions in a matrixed environment.
Lead through influence while building team capability, driving strong execution, and connecting strategic priorities to day-to-day action.

Keys to Success

Education

Advanced degrees in Genetics, Proteomics, Genomics, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field, with significant experience in genetics or genomics, including hands-on understanding of laboratory workflows, downstream analysis, and biological interpretation.

Experience

Demonstrated interest in and practical understanding of how AI can improve scientific software and laboratory workflows.
Proven ability to think strategically and contribute to future workflow and software direction, not just tactical execution.
Demonstrated ability to lead people and influence cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment, including effective partnership across Product Management, UX, Software Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams.

Preferred

Familiarity with responsible AI, workflow automation, and decision-support concepts in regulated environments.
Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory environments, including FDA, ISO 13485, IVDR, or forensic accreditation standards, where applicable.

Leadership Profile

Ability to connect strategy to roadmap and drive successful execution
Demonstrated leadership in a matrixed environment
Ability to lead and develop high-performing teams
Strong judgment and comfort operating in ambiguity
Innovation mindset balanced with scientific rigor and customer trust

Travel

Approximately 20-30%, including customer visits, internal meetings, workshops, conferences, and cross-site collaboration.

Other

Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check and drug screen.

Compensation And Benefits

The salary range estimated for this position based in California is $163,100.00–$217,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

added.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Device Platform Middleware
added.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About The Role

At Skydio, the combination of our platform, technology foundation, and team enables our engineers and researchers to develop, deploy, iterate, and improve upon the state of the art in robot autonomy better and faster than anywhere else in the world.

The middleware team sits in between the hardware platform and the autonomy stack and develops abstractions that are used by many of the layers that are higher up in the stack, including customer facing features. The team is small but with a broad impact: we design on-device services for all our drone platforms (X10, R10, F10) and their hardware configurations (Dock, External Radio and Controllers).

Some Of The Features That We Work On Are

Over The Air Updates
Inter Process Communication
Media and Log Management
Performance of code and systems on the aircraft
Time Synchronization
Aircraft Attachments
Navigation Cameras Streaming Pipeline
Automated Test Infrastructure

This is a highly impactful team where ownership matters. We work closely with other engineers across the company including Computer Vision, State Estimation, Fleet Management, and Embedded.

We're looking for a hands-on manager — someone who leads a small team, stays close to the code, and is as comfortable in a design review as in a career conversation.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Lead, grow, and retain a team of software engineers — running 1:1s, setting expectations, giving direct feedback, and developing engineers at every level.
Own the team's roadmap and delivery: set technical direction, break down ambiguous problems, and make the tradeoffs that keep the team shipping reliably.
Stay hands-on. Design and implement high-quality software systems that run on our hardware products and developer workstations, and remain a credible technical voice in reviews and architecture decisions.
Build analytics tools that help us monitor services and identify, architect, and implement projects that ensure smooth customer experiences, operating at a high state of reliability.
Identify and lead internal cross-team software projects that substantially improve the customer (internal and external) experience.
Take ownership of internal services from concept through deployment and monitoring.
Partner with Computer Vision, State Estimation, Fleet Management, Embedded and Product teams to align priorities and unblock work across organizational boundaries.
Recruit and hire — build the interview loop, sell candidates on the mission, and raise the bar with every addition to the team.

What Makes You a Good Fit

8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
3+ years of direct people management experience — you've owned headcount, performance, and career growth for a team of engineers.
You're a hands-on manager. You still read and write code, and you'd be uncomfortable leading a team whose work you couldn't do yourself.
You are comfortable navigating and delivering within a complex codebase.
You are highly proficient in Python and/or C++, implementing features in a Linux environment.
You enjoy designing and making powerful tools that are used by other engineers.
You are excited to work on and with modern cutting-edge robotic systems.
You are experienced in designing features for operating systems that run in resource constrained environments (compute and memory).
You have experience coordinating and leading improvements to systems with significant organizational usage and impact.
You've built software for systems with complex hardware in the loop — humanoid robots, unmanned vehicles, manufacturing / warehouse robots, drones, medical devices, IoT devices or similar — and you understand what changes when the bits have to move something physical.
You thrive in a fast-moving, process-light environment. You bring your own structure where it's needed, tolerate ambiguity, and optimize for impact over ceremony.
You're strong at stakeholder management. You keep partner teams and leadership informed, negotiate priorities and tradeoffs across organizational boundaries, and build the trust that gets your team unblocked.
Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

Compensation:
At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $230,000 - $303,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.

For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/

added.title: Director AI Engineering (Remote Eligible)
added.description:
At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The Generative AI Training team builds the platform Capital One's scientists and engineers use to train, fine-tune, and experiment with foundation models at scale. We run the GPU clusters and distributed training infrastructure behind the company's generative AI: fair-share scheduling across teams, large-scale fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, resilience for long-running jobs, and the utilization controls that keep that expensive hardware working efficiently. We also provide the self-service environments where teams deploy, serve, and evaluate models during experimentation, built on tools like KServe and vLLM. The platform we build is a central leverage point for AI across Capital One, shaping how fast and how affordable the rest of the company can build with foundation models.

What You’ll Do:

Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and operation of the platform's core systems: distributed training and fine-tuning, reinforcement learning workflows, fair-share GPU scheduling, job resilience and fault tolerance, GPU utilization and efficiency, and self-service environments for model experimentation and evaluation.
Make high judgment build-vs-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more.
Invent and introduce state-of-the-art techniques to improve the scalability, cost, throughput, and reliability of large-scale distributed training and fine-tuning.
Own GPU capacity planning and cost governance: right-size clusters, instance types, and quotas to the needs of training and experimentation workloads across teams.
Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state-of-the-art in AI.
Translate the enterprise AI strategy into portfolio-level execution plans across multiple product areas, balancing innovation with delivery discipline
Scale AI engineering practices across teams through shared infrastructure, reusable components, and unified observability and governance frameworks
Establish enterprise standard for Responsible AI, including fairness metrics, model evaluation protocols, documentation requirements, and audit readiness
Partner with research, compliance, and enterprise risk teams to ensure deployed systems meet emerging ethical and regulatory standards

The Ideal Candidate:

You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands-on when necessary and lead by example
You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven
You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss
You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 8 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
At least 3 years of people leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications:

5+ years of experience managing and leading an engineering team
7+ years of experience building and operating large-scale ML or GPU training infrastructure on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
Hands-on experience with distributed training at scale: multi-node, multi-GPU jobs and parallelism strategies (e.g., PyTorch FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron), with proficiency in Python, Go, C++, or CUDA
Experience with the ML orchestration and scheduling stack (e.g., Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Kueue, Slurm, Ray, KServe, vLLM)
Experience operating large GPU fleets with a focus on reliability, fault tolerance, utilization, and cost efficiency
Experience right-sizing GPU clusters, instance types, interconnect, and quotas to training and experimentation workload requirements (e.g., model size, parallelism strategy, throughput targets)
Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI and ML-systems research, and judiciously applying novel training and optimization techniques
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI and infrastructure concepts to peers
Experience building and leading a multi-team AI organization delivering multiple enterprise capabilities concurrently
Proven ability to expand and execute long-term AI platform strategies aligned to enterprise priorities and regulatory frameworks
Experience establishing cross-functional operating rhythms and review cadences (OKRs, AI governance councils, quarterly reviews)

Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

added.title: Director, Platform Architecture
added.description:
At Deckers Brands, Together, Every Step is a promise kept that every employee can bring their authentic self, is valued and supported, as a whole person, at work and beyond. Together, Every Step is how we continue to deliver exceptional business results, experience an amazing place to work, and have a positive impact on the communities and world around us.

Job Title:
Director, Platform Architecture

Reports to:
Chief Digital & Data Officer

Location:
United States (Remote)

Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Indiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Washington

The Role

As the Director, Platform Architecture, you will define and scale Deckers’ modern data and analytics platform architecture, ensuring it is secure, scalable, governed, and optimized for performance and cost. You’ll establish foundational architectural frameworks, technology standards, and best practices for our cloud-native platform, with AWS as the core environment. Collaborating with data architects, platform and DevOps engineering teams, product leaders, and governance specialists, you’ll enable analytics, AI, and domain-driven data products across the enterprise through reusable platform services, robust security and access controls, and clear operational standards.

We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.

Your Impact

Support the development of the enterprise data platform strategy aligned with business objectives and digital transformation initiatives
Define and maintain the architectural blueprint and reference architecture for the cloud-native data platform using AWS as the core environment
Establish principles and patterns for platform scalability, reliability, security, observability, and cost optimization across platform services and shared capabilities
Design and maintain standards for platform architecture layers including infrastructure, networking, identity and access management, audit logging, metadata management, access control, and observability
Partner with domain architects and engineering teams to ensure shared platform services are reusable, modular, and governed, and that domain teams can self-serve effectively
Guide the adoption of platform services and tools that enable data mesh, pub-sub models, event-driven architectures, and self-serve data product delivery
Lead evaluation and selection of core platform technologies and services, ensuring they meet business needs for analytics, real-time streaming, governance, and machine learning enablement
Promote architectural patterns that enable resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, and rapid delivery, including standards for automation, environment management, and operational readiness
Partner with Data Governance, Security, and Compliance teams to embed privacy, security, and audit-readiness into platform architecture and delivery practices
Define standards for metadata capture, lineage tracking, data quality measurement, and access management across platform services and tooling
Provide architectural leadership and mentorship to platform engineers, DevOps teams, and data engineering teams, including design reviews and technical guidance
Collaborate with Program Delivery, Product Management, and architecture peers to align roadmaps, sequencing, and execution plans across multiple teams
Influence platform design decisions across the organization and drive alignment to enterprise goals through standards, reference implementations, and review processes
Support vendor evaluations, licensing decisions, and long-term technology investments for the platform ecosystem, including total cost of ownership considerations

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field; Master’s degree preferred
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or equivalent certifications are highly preferred
10 to 15 years of experience in platform architecture, data architecture, or enterprise systems design
5 or more years of leadership experience building or scaling cloud-native data platforms, ideally on AWS
Experience supporting modern data architectures including lakehouse models, real-time streaming, and domain-oriented data products
Experience in the retail, consumer products, or e-commerce industry is preferred but not required
Deep expertise in AWS cloud services related to data storage, compute, networking, security, and auditability, including services such as S3, Redshift, Glue, Lake Formation, EMR, Kinesis, IAM, VPC, and CloudTrail
Knowledge of distributed computing frameworks, modern file formats and open table standards including Parquet and Iceberg
Familiarity with governance, cataloging, lineage, and privacy frameworks and regulations including GDPR and CCPA
Deep understanding of modern cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, and data platform technologies
Strong leadership skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority
Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities in complex, fast-paced environments
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Ability to foster innovation, drive continuous improvement, and create scalable technical frameworks
Comfortable working in a global, matrixed organization with a proactive, results-driven approach

What We'll Give You –

Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.
Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.

$154,700.00 - $208,800.00

Goleta, California (Remote)

Individual pay will be determined by location and additional factors, including job related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Diversity and inclusion are key to our success. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences and backgrounds who share a passion for our brands. We welcome qualified applicants regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, mental or physical disability, medical condition and all the other beautiful parts of your identity.

added.title: Director, IT Infrastructure
added.description:
About Rocket Lab

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

IT

Rocket Lab’s IT team is responsible for how our global teams access information and run operations across our computer systems, networks, and devices. Our hardworking IT team is a group of flexible problem-solvers working in a fast-paced environment but who also thrive under the challenge of supporting all of our proprietary systems and people, from finance to launch operations.

DIRECTOR, IT INFRASTRUCTURE

Based onsite at either our Long Beach, CA or Auckland, NZ facilities, the Director, IT Infrastructure reports to the CIO and develops IT support system strategies, processes and procedures to deliver reliable, repeatable, and scalable information technology solutions to meet Rocket Lab’s expanding business needs. This employee will ensure the efficient delivery of technology to meet the needs of Rocket Lab employees while ensuring high level of security and compliance standards.

What You'll Get To Do

Development of a high performing team of IT engineers, located around the world, with priority on enabling our engineers to design, develop, and manufacture world class technology products and solutions.
Leader in compute, storage, network, OS, and Devops technologies required to support a dynamic engineering company that is developing the latest Rocket and Satellite technology.
Defines and manages IT infrastructure priorities with business leaders of Space Systems and Launch Operation teams to ensure aggressive business priorities are achieved by the team.
Develops industry leading processes and procedures for manage global infrastructures services across many Rocket Lab facilities, with on-premises infrastructure as well as cloud-based infrastructure, while delivering high availably and uptime.
Ensures fleet of infrastructure equipment meets Rocket Lab security and compliance standards.
Develops relationships with vendors for procurement of IT software and hardware. Negotiates most favorable agreements for Rocket Lab.
Develop strategy for 24x7 global support model.
Travel domestically and internationally up to 30% of the time to support IT infrastructure operations globally.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

12+ years' experience with increasing responsibility in IT infrastructure with Operations, Data Centers, Virtualization, O365, Networks, Support, and Security.
IT leadership in a globally diverse organization.
Experience in high tech, engineering and/or manufacturing organizations.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or other relevant fields.
US citizenship is required, due to program requirements.

These Qualifications Would Be Nice To Have

Experience in a high-availability 24/7 Cloud/AWS/Azure and On-Prem environment.
Technical expertise in components like Windows, Linux, VMWare, iSeries, Networking, SAN, Switches, Firewall, Wifi and Access Points, etc.
Experience with M&A (due diligence, integration planning, execution) and impacts on IT.
Prior experience in rapid growth environment.

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base Pay Range (CA Only): $174,800 USD - $233,000 USD

What To Expect

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important Information

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. added.title: Senior Director, Product Management - Supply Chain Technology
added.description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day—building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with limitless entrepreneurial spirit, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Director, Product Management — Supply Chain Technology will play a critical role in transforming fulfillment, distribution, and global shipping infrastructure powering fan delivery worldwide.

Role Overview

This is a rare, high-impact leadership role in which the Senior Director, Product Management — Supply Chain Technology owns the product strategy and execution across Fanatics Commerce's fulfillment and distribution network, warehouse management systems, and global shipping platforms — the full physical flow of product from our facilities to customers and wholesale partners worldwide. Reporting to the VP of Product Management, this leader will guide a focused team of experienced Product Managers in close partnership with Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, and executive leadership to translate a bold network transformation strategy into a sequenced, deliverable roadmap. The Senior Director, Product Management — Supply Chain Technology delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

How Will You Drive Impact

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner with Engineering and Architecture on platform scalability, reliability, and supply chain technology strategy, managing complex dependencies across multi-team, multi-vendor programs to drive alignment and unblock delivery.
Work with Finance to model and track program ROI, total cost of ownership, and business impact across the network transformation portfolio, and actively participate in executive-level program reviews and strategic planning cycles.
Lead build vs. buy evaluations and vendor selection decisions in partnership with Operations, Supply Chain, and Logistics — ensuring technology choices are grounded in operational reality across parcel, freight, last-mile, and regional carriers globally.

People Leadership

Build and develop a small, mighty team of Product Managers across fulfillment, distribution, WMS, and shipping domains — setting clear direction, managing prioritization across competing demands, and growing talent.
Create an environment where product managers are close to the business, empowered to make decisions, and accountable for outcomes.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

Drive shipping capabilities across B2C, B2B, and enterprise fulfillment models — including cross-border and customs compliance — ensuring fans and wholesale partners receive their product on time, every time.
Define and track shipping performance metrics across on-time delivery, cost, carrier performance, and customer experience, in partnership with Logistics and Operations.
Drive our micro-fulfillment model — enabling on-demand capacity and pop-up sites that power Fanatics Commerce's ability to respond to peak events and hot market moments, ensuring fan demand is met at every surge.
Ensure platform decisions balance customer experience, operational scalability, cost efficiency, and compliance across both B2C and B2B models.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

Define and evolve the product vision for Fanatics Commerce's Global Shipping platform — spanning carrier integrations, TMS strategy, rate shopping, label generation, package lifecycle management, and delivery tracking.
Own automation integration strategy across warehouse execution, controls, and robotics systems — translating operational automation investments into coherent product architecture.
Champion low-touch logistics execution — driving automation, intelligent carrier selection, and streamlined fulfillment routing to reduce freight costs, minimize manual intervention, and improve throughput across the shipping lifecycle.
Enable greenfield deployments and complex retrofit programs across a growing global network spanning North America, Europe, and beyond — building toward a uniform, modern technology platform for omnichannel operations.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

Lead and co-develop the product strategy and multi-year roadmap for Fanatics Commerce's Warehouse Management System platform, driving a large-scale, multi-site network transformation program across the global network in close partnership with Supply Chain and Operations.
Translate strategy into clear product requirements, epics, and measurable success criteria — leading backlog prioritization and sprint planning in close partnership with engineering teams.
Define and track network performance metrics across fulfillment efficiency, distribution accuracy, system reliability, and cost, in alignment with Operations and business stakeholders.
Navigate peak event planning and operational resilience requirements — including holiday, promotional surges, and hot market events — with rigor and a relentless delivery mindset.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

12+ years of Product Management experience with significant ownership of WMS, fulfillment, distribution, or supply chain platforms, including a proven track record leading complex, multi-site technology transformation programs from strategy through delivery.
Deep expertise in warehouse management systems at enterprise scale — Manhattan Active WMS or equivalent strongly preferred — with demonstrated experience driving both eCommerce and wholesale distribution operations.
Strong understanding of global shipping, carrier integrations, TMS strategy, and last-mile logistics, including demonstrated experience designing or scaling low-touch logistics models such as automated carrier selection, rate shopping optimization, and reduction of manual touchpoints across the shipping and fulfillment lifecycle.
Experience operating across B2C and B2B fulfillment and distribution models, with the ability to ensure platform decisions balance customer experience, operational scalability, cost efficiency, and compliance.
Experience leading and developing teams of Product Managers — setting direction, managing performance, and growing talent in a fast-paced, high-complexity environment.
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with demonstrated comfort operating at the VP and C-suite level across Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Finance, and Engineering.
Strong analytical capabilities — able to build business cases, model total cost of ownership, and track program-level impact across a multi-year network transformation portfolio.

WORK LOCATION

Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Atlanta, GA OR San Mateo, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday.

The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

$204,000 - $255,000 USD

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About The Team

Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, www.fanatics.com.

Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).

At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:

Build Championship Teams
Obsessed with Fans
Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit
Determined and Relentless Mindset

added.title: Deputy Head of Production, Altius
added.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Site

Anduril, a leader in autonomous systems and weapons manufacturing, is building Arsenal-1
, its first hyperscale manufacturing facility, just south of Columbus, Ohio in Pickaway County. Arsenal-1 is redefining the scale and speed with which autonomous systems and weapons can be produced for the United States and its allies and partners. This is a monumental and essential step toward rebuilding America’s defense industrial base, strengthening warfighting capabilities, and enhancing deterrence amid rising international threats.

About The Product

The Launched Effects
team at Anduril is responsible for scaling the manufacturing and delivery of the Altius
family of systems. As the premier Air-Launched Effects (ALE) platform for the U.S. military and its allies, Altius is redefining modern warfare. These tube-launched, autonomous aerial systems must be built to survive extreme deployment environments, requiring precision manufacturing of advanced composites, complex avionics, and modular payload integrations for ISR, Electronic Warfare, and kinetic strike capabilities.

About The Team

The Altius Leadership Team will set the standard for building the future at Arsenal-1
, our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility. This team will have the opportunity to train alongside our world-class manufacturing teams both at headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA and alongside the main production lines in Atlanta for 3 months before bringing that standard of operational excellence back to launch and scale production in Ohio.

About The Role

As the Altius Deputy Head of Production, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of defense manufacturing by leading the day-to-day operations and scaling of Anduril’s Altius product line at Arsenal-1. You will own the strategic development and execution of manufacturing operations, driving products from initial ramp to full-rate production while building a foundational culture of high performance and urgency.

This role requires a dynamic, factory-floor leader who can serve as both a strategic architect and a hands-on executor—rallying cross-functional teams, developing the next generation of manufacturing leaders, and serving as an inspiring communicator across the floor and to executive leadership.

Leadership & Culture Building: Serve as an inspiring, visible leader on the factory floor. Build Arsenal-1’s operational culture from the ground up, instill a relentless sense of urgency, and actively mentor and develop frontline supervisors and technical leaders beneath you.
Cross-Functional Execution: Direct and align on-site teams—including Technicians, Manufacturing Engineers, Quality, and tactical Supply Chain personnel—holding teams accountable to strict deadlines, output targets, and KPIs.
Showpiece Facility Standards: Establish and maintain Arsenal-1 as a benchmark "showpiece" manufacturing facility—a world-class showcase of advanced aerospace manufacturing for customer, government, and VIP visits.
Operational & Quality Excellence: Drive processes and systems needed to mature products to full-rate production. Embed an AS9100D-aligned "quality-first" culture and continuously optimize KPIs across scrap rates, efficiency, financial targets, and on-time delivery.
Process & Technology Advancement: Advise on development and oversee the implementation of digital tools (PLM, ERP, MES, and QMS) to scale operations rapidly while maintaining tight configuration control.
Own the 5 Pillars: Planning, Supply Chain, Production, Manufacturing Engineering, and Quality.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of proven experience overseeing the production, assembly, and testing of complex electromechanical or aerospace hardware.
Strong leadership experience managing large (100+ person) manufacturing operations, with direct experience leading technicians, manufacturing engineers, and production teams.
Demonstrated experience building or scaling production lines from the ground up (e.g., prototype-to-production scaling, greenfield site launches, or high-growth startup environments).
Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with a track record of building team culture, winning buy-in across all-hands environments, and communicating effectively upward and downward.
A strong background in quality assurance and process discipline, with accountability to standards such as AS9100D.
High ownership mindset with the ability to manage CapEx, headcount, and schedule milestones with intense urgency.
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.
Ability to work onsite five days a week at our Ashville, OH campus (Arsenal-1), with initial flexibility to complete an onboarding/training rotation at HQ in Costa Mesa, CA and Atlanta, GA.

Preferred Qualifications

Military / Veteran background or experience leading defense-critical manufacturing operations.
Demonstrated success establishing greenfield manufacturing facilities or standing up new production cells under tight timelines.
Deep experience working with niche supply chains in aerospace, defense, or robotics.
Hands-on experience implementing and leveraging modern digital manufacturing toolchains (custom MES, ERP, PLM, QMS).

added.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Role Overview

Bristol Myers Squibb is seeking a strategic, scientifically grounded leader to serve as the Senior Director for Clinical Pharmacology & Pharmacometrics. This leader will partner deeply with Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacometrics, Quantitative Pharmacology, and Translational Medicine stakeholders to deliver the applications, modeling environments, workflow automation, and governed operational capabilities that support CPP work end to end—from quantitative preclinical-to-clinical bridging through clinical PK/PD, dose and regimen decisions, and submission-support outputs.

This role supports the quantitative CPP layer across Research and Development, including pharmacometric workflows, clinical PK/PD systems, modeling platforms, reporting automation, regulatory evidence generation, and the governed operational capabilities required to run these workflows at scale.

Reporting to the Vice President, Research Business Insights & Technology, this leader will operate as part of a unified BI&T leadership team and act as a trusted partner to Research and Development leadership. The role carries accountability for the reliability, fit-for-purpose evolution, and long-term scaling of the CPP technology stack and workflow ecosystem, while working in a highly matrixed model with scientific leaders, data teams, lab-platform teams, and regulatory-facing partners.

Mission & Impact

Provide a scalable application and workflow backbone for CPP across preclinical-to-clinical translation, clinical PK/PD, dose selection, exposure-response, and model-informed development decisions
Improve the speed, quality, reproducibility, traceability, and inspection-readiness of pharmacometrics and clinical pharmacology workflows
Strengthen regulatory submissions through robust reporting, reusable quantitative evidence generation, and auditable outputs that support documents such as clinical pharmacology summaries and model-based appendices
Enable governed automation of priority CPP workflows, including reporting, simulation, execution, review, and knowledge reuse
Create a durable technology foundation for end-to-end CPP that can scale with pipeline demand and integrate cleanly across the broader Research and Development ecosystem

Sub-Areas in Scope

Clinical pharmacology and pharmacometrics applications, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose optimization, and model-informed decision support
PBPK, QSP, drug-drug interaction, and other quantitative modeling environments used in CPP workflows
Clinical PK/PD systems and operational tooling that support end-to-end CPP execution
CPAR, Quarto-based or similar reporting automation, and submission-support workflows for quantitative regulatory deliverables
Quantitative translational workflows that bridge preclinical and clinical evidence in support of CPP decision-making
Workflow governance, audit trails, validation support, access controls, and inspection-ready operational practices for regulated quantitative environments
AI-enabled and advanced analytics capabilities that improve CPP workflow efficiency, simulation, review, reporting, and knowledge reuse
In partnership, but not sole ownership: translational labs, pathology, molecular and imaging lab workflows, CLIA-oriented lab operations, precision medicine diagnostics, and broad bioanalytical capabilities

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the single BI&T point of accountability for CPP technology, applications, workflows, and support services end to end
Partner across Research and Development to integrate CPP workflows with the scientific, data, and operational capabilities required for model-informed drug development
Own clinical pharmacology and pharmacometrics applications, modeling environments, reporting workflows, and operational support for core CPP use cases
Ensure operational excellence, reliability, governance, and continuous improvement across modeling environments, clinical PK/PD systems, reporting workflows, and submission-support applications
Lead automation of priority CPP workflows, including model execution, reporting, simulation, traceability, review, and evidence reuse
Support quantitative regulatory deliverables through fit-for-purpose tooling, reproducible workflows, and inspection-ready practices
Partner with Unified Lab & Experimental Platforms, Target & Disease Biology, and In-Vivo & Non-Clinical Pharmacology where translational science, lab systems, diagnostics, biomarker workflows, or bioanalytical capabilities intersect with CPP needs
Partner with the R&D Data organization on underlying data-product strategy, integration, and fit-for-purpose data access
Lead and grow a team of scientific technologists, product leaders, and specialized engineers aligned to this domain

Required Experience & Qualifications

Ph.D. in Pharmacometrics, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biostatistics, or related quantitative field
12+ years in pharmaceutical R&D with deep clinical pharmacology, pharmacometrics, and model-informed drug development experience
Proven experience implementing or leading CPP applications, PBPK and QSP environments, clinical PK/PD systems, or quantitative workflow automation
Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory submissions, quantitative reporting, and governed workflows in Development-facing settings
Experience applying AI/ML or advanced automation to quantitative modeling, reporting, or regulated scientific workflows is preferred
Director or Senior Director-level leadership experience; experience building and scaling a specialized scientific technology team is a strong differentiator

Critical Capabilities

Scientific Depth in Clinical Pharmacology and Pharmacometrics — Deep credibility with quantitative scientists and domain leaders across CPP
Strategic Partnership — Translates scientific and Development needs into practical, integrated technology and workflow solutions
Operational Leadership — Builds reliable, scalable, inspection-ready environments and support models for critical quantitative workflows
Regulatory Translation Capability — Understands how quantitative evidence is prepared, reported, reviewed, and used in regulatory settings

Leadership & Change Attributes

Strong partnership with senior scientific, clinical, and regulatory leaders
Comfort operating with regulatory and global Development stakeholders
Ability to recruit, develop, and retain highly specialized quantitative talent in a competitive market
Experience navigating matrixed organizations and building credibility quickly
Commitment to building a collaborative, high-performing culture in a growing team

What Differentiates Top Candidates

Experience as a clinical pharmacology or pharmacometrics technology leader inside a top-tier pharmaceutical R&D organization
Track record of applications, workflows, or platforms that improved dose selection, quantitative decision-making, or regulatory execution in Development-facing settings
Experience deploying workflow automation, AI-enabled capabilities, or advanced analytics in support of end-to-end CPP modeling, reporting, and decision-support operations
Demonstrated success building a specialized function from foundational capability to scaled organizational value while operating through strong matrix partnerships

added.title: Director, Product Development, AI Enablement
added.description:
Director, Product Management (PXDP60)

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About The Team

The Enterprise Data team is dedicated to maximizing the value of our data ecosystem, enabling real-time, intelligent experiences built upon a scalable and future-proof foundation. We are a highly collaborative, cross-functional organization. Our work involves harmonizing product, technology, design, risk, and other key partners to forge a modern data ecosystem. Within Enterprise Data, our team features one of the most highly-engaged, creative tech partnerships, experimenting with AI enablement tools, bringing product rigor to how we measure success, and cultivating a culture of relentless innovation and customer obsession.

About The Role

A Director of AI Enablement Product Management is a strategic hands-on product leader who will fundamentally rethink how the eData product organization - and ultimately Capital One - works with AI. You will act as the tip of the spear in driving enterprise-wide adoption of AI workflows, transforming our operations at every level: the tools we build, the processes we follow, and the mechanisms we use to measure success. Unlike traditional product managers who focus on deterministic software features, or AI-native product managers who train foundational models, an enablement product manager focuses on the operational layer: transforming AI capabilities, architecture blueprints, and developer platforms into scalable productivity tools and resilient infrastructure.

Specifically, the Director will:

AI Platform Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year product roadmap for internal AI infrastructure tailored to enterprise operations.
Intelligent Workflows: Architect and deploy autonomous AI agents and advanced RAG systems to transform high-friction processes.
Blueprint & Standard Rollout: Create and deploy enterprise patterns, guardrails, and AI architectures across engineering and non-engineering functions for a faster, better quality outcome of the product development process, embedding responsible AI practices (transparency, explainability, compliance).
Workflow Transformation: Replace manual toil and high-friction processes with reusable platform components and AI agents.
Data Democratization & Integration: Build intuitive AI-driven semantic layers and integrate agentic AI/ML capabilities into core front-to-back workflows via flexible integration techniques (API, MCP, CLI).
Governance, Compliance & Security: Establish ironclad LLM evaluation pipelines and guardrails that ensure strict data privacy, compliance, and zero-hallucination thresholds for reporting.
Adoption & Change Management: Partner with internal champions and partners to ensure behavioral adoption rather than just feature deployment.
Cross-Functional Synergy: Act as the primary strategic translator between core data engineering teams, corporate finance executives, legal teams, and business unit leaders.
Feedback Loops: Serve as the structured bridge between business users and core infrastructure or engineering teams to refine future product strategy.

Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

Human Centered
- Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions

Business Focused
- Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence

Technology Driven
- Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value

Integrated Problem Solving
- Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks

Transformational Leadership
- Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 5 years of Product Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products
