added.title: Engineering Director
added.description:
About Bestow

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities.

Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.gov .

About The Team

The Engineering team is the core of Bestow, driving all technology for our SaaS platform that empowers insurance carriers. We build and operate the systems that serve our enterprise carrier partners across the entire lifecycle of a life insurance policy, our consumers, and our employees. Within Bestow Engineering, our major functional teams are product engineering, infrastructure engineering, IT, data and analytics, and technical program management. Engineering partners closely with Product Management, Experience Design, and Delivery Management to define and prioritize the roadmap and to hold our commitments to carrier partners and to the business.

Our primary technologies are a microservices architecture in Golang, Python, and TypeScript on PostgreSQL, integrated over gRPC, REST, and asynchronous messaging, with event sourcing in our configuration and domain layers. We deploy and operate on Kubernetes in Google Cloud Platform.

This role reports to the VP of Engineering, manages a group of Engineering Managers, and is open to Remote (US).

Who You Are

The Director of Engineering for Insurance Product Configuration & Enrollment Platform Core will be a highly technical, strategic engineering leader who is comfortable owning outcomes that span teams you manage and teams you do not. You are comfortable leading cross-team initiatives, even with teams who do not report to you. You understand distributed systems deeply, you can hold a firm line on quality in a regulated domain, and you are energized by building the managers and engineers on your team.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
8+ years of professional software development experience.
5+ years of progressive engineering management experience, including managing managers. You will lead 2–3 Engineering Managers and roughly 20–30 engineers across multiple teams.
Proven ability to design, build, and operate distributed systems and microservices architectures at scale, including event-driven and event-sourced designs.
Extensive experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including schema design, data modeling, and query performance.
Strong background in Golang and/or Python backend services, API design (gRPC, REST), and asynchronous messaging patterns.
Strong advocate for agentic engineering, who has recently transformed at least one team to fully embrace agentic engineering
Deep expertise across the software development lifecycle — inception, design, planning, delivering, continuous delivery, release strategy, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Credible across adjacent boundaries you do not own. You can reason about the frontend composition layer, data platform, and infrastructure well enough to negotiate interfaces, review designs, and resolve cross-team failures without escalating everything.
Ability to 'go deep' technically when it matters. You can contribute changes to your teams' codebases and engage credibly in architectural decisions at any time.
Advocate for automated testing and test-driven development, with real opinions on how to test configuration and rules at scale.
Experience with cloud platforms, with a preference for Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes.
Ability to define and track key metrics, drive accountability across teams, and consistently meet committed dates and SLAs.
Highly organized, with a demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities across multiple teams and partner commitments at once.
Proven ability to attract, hire, mentor, and retain top-tier engineering talent, including developing senior engineers and early-career managers.
Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain a complex system and its trade-offs to an executive, a carrier partner, and an engineer in the same day.
Life insurance, annuities, or other regulated-industry experience is a strong plus, as is experience delivering implementations for enterprise or carrier partners under contractual dates.

What You'll Do

Strategic Technical Leadership

Define and drive the technical vision for your teams Core, and make sure it ladders up to Bestow's platform strategy and business objectives.
Push configuration-driven repeatability over bespoke per-partner work, so that each new carrier implementation costs less and ships faster than the last.
Provide architectural guidance and oversight across the configuration layer, the enrollment workflow engine, and the event-sourced domain services, keeping them scalable, reliable, secure, and performant.
Lead initiatives whose success depends on teams that do not report to you, and make measurable impact at the vertical and org level rather than only inside your own scope.
Own the interfaces between your teams and the ones you depend on and resolve ambiguity about ownership before it becomes an incident or a slipped date.
Represent Bestow credibly with carrier partners, vendors, and other technology companies, including in technical due diligence and vendor negotiations.
Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate honestly what belongs on our platform.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning, in partnership with our Principal engineers and other engineering leaders.

Delivery and Operational Excellence

Own your teams' delivery commitments to carrier partners, including UAT handoff dates, and represent that status accurately to executive leadership.
Head off requirements churn at the source. Partner with Product, Delivery Management, Underwriting, and Compliance to surface missing requirements and cross-team dependencies during discovery, when a gap costs a conversation rather than a release.
Own your organization's incident posture. Drive urgency and priority grading, insist on real root-cause analysis, look across incidents for systemic causes, and close the loop on follow-up actions.
Hold the principle that the team owning a service owns its operation, including the supporting infrastructure, and work with platform engineering to make that practical rather than nominal.
Ability to build a testing strategy that scales with the rules and configuration we ship — automated coverage, human-readable outcomes for underwriting and compliance reviewers, and repeatable regression runs in place of thousand-case manual test fests.
Champion data and metrics for technical decisions, system health, and the impact of engineering investment.
Translate business requirements and partner roadmaps into clear technical strategies and staffing plans, balancing near-term commitments against long-term maintainability and security.

Team Leadership and Development

Lead, mentor, and grow a group of Engineering Managers, and build the leadership bench under them.
Build, nurture, and scale high-performing teams with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and psychological safety.
Run performance management with rigor: career ladder expectations, scorecards, calibration, direct feedback, personalized growth plans, and prompt action on individual or team challenges.
Maintain bench depth and knowledge redundancy so that a single departure or absence does not put a partner commitment at risk.
Act as hiring manager for your organization's open requisitions. Own the funnel with recruiting, participate in the hiring cadence, and raise the bar with every hire.
Manage our contractor and vendor partners as part of one team — same expectations, same calibration, same quality bar as our full-time engineers.
Establish engineering processes and ceremonies that make teams faster, and remove the ones that do not.

Agentic Engineering Leadership

Direct the adoption of AI-augmented development in your organization rather than delegating it. Set the strategy for where AI changes how we build, and hold your teams to it.
Drive adoption of AI development tooling (Claude Code, Claude Tag, GitHub Copilot) and AI-first delivery practices such as AIDLC across your teams, and measure whether adoption is producing real leverage.
Establish standards for AI-generated code — review requirements, automated testing, and documentation workflows — that reduce technical debt instead of accelerating its creation.
Partner with Security, IT, and Compliance to expand what AI tooling we can safely use, proposing compensating controls rather than stopping at a blocked request.
Coach engineers and managers against the AI competencies in our career ladders, and evaluate for them when you hire and when you calibrate.
Build leverage with AI instead of consuming engineering capacity. Turn recurring questions from Product, Design, and new engineers into durable, self-serve knowledge.

The ideal candidate is a technical, inspiring leader who can hold two things at once: a partner implementation that has to ship on a contractual date, and a platform that has to get easier to configure every quarter. You are as comfortable in an architecture review as in a calibration session, and your teams get better because you lead them.

TOTAL REWARDS

Benefits

At Bestow, we’re proud to be awarded for our team members, innovative products, and culture. Our standard benefits for full-time employees include:

Competitive salary and equity based on role
Policies and managers that support work/life balance, like our flexible paid time off and parental leave programs
100% paid-premium option for medical, dental, and vision insurance
Lifestyle stipend to support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing
Flexible work-from-home policy and open to remote
Remote and WFH options, as well as a beautiful, state-of-the-art office in Dallas’ Deep Ellum, for those who prefer an office setting
Employee-led diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

Recent Employer Awards Include

Best Place for Working Parents 2023 + 2024 + 2025
Great Place to Work Certified, 2022 + 2023 + 2024 + 2025
Built In Best Places to Work, 2022 + 2023 + 2025
Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Texas 2022 + 2023
Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance 2022 + 2023 + 2024

We value diversity at Bestow. The company will hire, recruit, and promote regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every team member.

Thanks for considering a job at Bestow!

added.title: Sr. Director, Validation Test Engineering
added.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a Sr. Director, Validation Test Engineering
located in Austin, TX.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer,
the Sr. Director, Validation Test Engineering
will establish and lead the OCTO validation, characterization, and qualification capability for SpinCo’s integrated data center platforms. This role will define validation strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, lab capabilities, test data infrastructure, and development lifecycle gates for advanced power, advanced cooling, controls, and integrated platform products. The role ensures SpinCo ships integrated systems that work reliably at the rack, pod, and data-center levels.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be active in your own deliverables, personally shaping test strategies, test plans, and acceptance criteria, digging into test data, and standing up lab and test capability rather than only directing others to do so. We are looking for a leader who sets the technical bar by engaging directly in validation and data, and who is measured by the reliability of what we ship.

What a typical day looks like:

added.description:
Job Description

The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse.

Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next.

We’re looking for a Director of Engineering
to join our technology team and lead the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands-on engineering role with core responsibilities around infrastructure services, data pipelines, personalization systems, consumer AI, internal AI tooling, and custom APIs across AWS and GCP projects.

You are a hands-on technical leader who builds robust high-performance services for websites. You will own the plumbing that enables our newsroom, data science, marketing, and product teams to deliver cutting-edge digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside technology leadership in a fast-paced newsroom. You will partner with editorial leaders, share architectural solutions with other business units in the US, UK, and Australia, and direct your engineering team with experienced tactics and thoughtful strategy.

Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Sponsorship, including employment visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position now or in the future.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and support a small team of high-achieving agile software and data engineers.
Design, build, and operate cloud-based APIs supporting specialized needs of our consumer websites, native mobile apps.
Work daily with compute services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery.
Be able to personally troubleshoot an issue from Javascript in a browser down through DNS, networking, applications, containers and operating systems or serverless services, and into dependent service tiers.
Own data ingestion pipelines for real-time and batch processing of large-scale content and event data.
Understand how to implement and scale custom APIs to support editorial workflows, AI, personalization, analytics, and user-facing applications.
Own the team’s codebases, pull requests, testing, maintenance and release process.
Partner with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs.
Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud-based systems.
Communicate and present a vision for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Organize architecture discussions.
Run and/or supervise agile sprint ceremonies.

Qualifications

Must-Haves

MS or BS in computer science, or related field.
10+ years of professional software engineering experience.
5+ years experience leading engineering teams.
Agile best practices.
Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, Node.js, or Go.
Solid familiarity of common AWS and/or GCP services .
Robust experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication/authorization, and API best practices.
Firm grasp of the tools of the trade including AI tools, IDEs, Git, JIRA, and agile methodologies.
Comfort with code reviews, unit tests, QA and UAT processes, and knowledge of end-to-end testing frameworks.
Strong troubleshooting skills
Attention to detail, thoroughness, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a comfort in diving in and learning things from scratch.
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Great-to-Have Experience

Familiarity with content-management systems, media, news, publishing, video technology, ad technology, or other high-traffic consumer-facing industries.
Hands-on experience with generative-AI models, LLM prompting, and/or machine learning.
Personalization and recommendation systems.
Experience building and deploying data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dataflow, Glue, or similar tools)
Comfort with Linux administration, shell scripting, ssh, crontabs, etc.
Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboard, and alarming tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.)
Knowledge of data warehouse technologies (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)
Understanding of CI/CD workflows and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes a plus)

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change).

Mercury* is building a complete financial stack for ambitious businesses. Since we launched in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 200,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world.

Within the Revenue Strategy & Operations group, the Platforms & Infrastructure team owns the systems, workflows, and processes that power Mercury's revenue organization across Sales, Partnerships, and Account Management. Our revenue org has grown past 100 sellers and is on a path to more than double. At that scale, our systems are how we change behavior and drive efficiency, and AI is fundamentally rewriting how these systems get built. We're looking for a leader to take advantage of that shift.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

As Head of Revenue Technology, you will:

Own the strategy and execution for the systems, workflows, and processes that power Mercury's revenue organization, serving three teams with distinct needs: Sales, Partnerships, and Account Management.
Take business problems, design solutions, and ship them fast. We iterate in weeks, not quarters, and we'd rather put something imperfect in front of users and improve it than wait for the perfect build.
Rebuild our revenue stack AI-first, both in what we ship (automation, scoring, agent-driven workflows) and in how we build it (using AI to do the development itself).
Be a hands-on builder. You'll bring a strong point of view, get into the work, and actively shape and design solutions alongside your team.
Translate fluently between business and technical. You'll deeply understand what the revenue org is trying to accomplish, then flip gears and architect how to get there.
Lead and grow a tenured team of admins, engineers, and architects, guiding them to a high-speed, iterative operating model.
Deliver value on top of imperfect foundations, while improving those foundations over time.
Develop and leverage strong stakeholder and partner relationships to build consensus and drive impact

There are lots of paths that could lead you to be successful in a role like this; we think the strongest candidates will have some of this experience:

15+ years working in and around revenue systems, GTM systems, or revenue architecture in a B2B environment, ideally at a revenue org of 250+ sellers.
5+ years managing teams.
Experience at a product-led company with a sales or revenue motion layered on top.
A track record of taking a business problem end to end: ingest it, design the solution, implement it, and do it quickly.
Hands-on experience deploying AI into GTM systems. If you've rebuilt an AI-powered GTM stack, that's our gold standard.
Salesforce fluency is useful, but your career doesn’t need to be defined by it. We're looking for people who took the non-standard route: product managers, systems builders, operators who taught themselves the technical side.
Proven change leadership: you've brought experienced teams through significant shifts in how they work.
Strong conviction and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders while staying close to the work.

Establish observability, capacity planning, performance testing and 24x7 production support.
Manage cloud and infrastructure cost (FinOps) as transaction volumes grow.
Establish IT service management disciplines covering incident, problem, change and service continuity management.

Evaluate emerging capabilities (AI-driven fraud controls, biometrics, tokenization, open banking APIs) and apply them where they add clear value.

added.description:
Our client is a privately held, family-owned apparel manufacturer with more than 60 years of leadership in its category, serving customers across North America and beyond. The company designs, produces, and distributes its products, handling every step from concept to delivered product in-house. A talented, tenured team and steady investment in people, products, and technology have built a culture rooted in craftsmanship and community. As the business continues to grow, it is investing in the systems and infrastructure that will define its next chapter and is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead that work.

This is a rare opportunity to step into a newly created leadership role with a direct line to senior operations leadership and a real hand in shaping how a respected manufacturer scales. Reporting to the SVP of Operations, the Director of Engineering will lead Engineering, Maintenance, Distribution, and Facilities across the organization. First, the role offers exceptional breadth, bringing automation, maintenance strategy, warehouse optimization, and facility investment together under a single leader. Second, it carries high visibility and influence, with ownership of day-to-day operational performance that frees senior leadership to focus on long-term strategy. Third, it offers the chance to lead major capital projects and modernization initiatives that will directly support the company's growth, while building and developing a high-performing team. This is a hybrid position based in St. Louis, Missouri, with an on-site schedule of approximately 70%.

Position Responsibilities

Develop and execute strategies for Engineering, Maintenance, Distribution, and Facilities that support company growth and operational objectives
Drive automation, technology adoption, and process improvements across manufacturing and distribution operations to increase efficiency and scalability
Lead warehouse, distribution, and logistics optimization initiatives that improve service levels, throughput, and customer delivery performance
Oversee capital expenditure planning, facility upgrades, infrastructure investments, and engineering projects from business case through completion
Lead preventative and predictive maintenance programs that maximize equipment reliability and uptime across multiple facilities
Optimize warehouse management systems, inventory movement, and distribution technologies to improve accuracy and material flow
Establish and monitor key performance indicators for productivity, safety, quality, cost, and asset utilization, and use the results to guide decisions
Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and executive leadership to align priorities and improve material flow across the business
Foster a culture of safety and accountability across maintenance and distribution operations
Build, coach, and develop high-performing teams while driving continuous improvement throughout the organization

Required

Position Qualifications

Proven track record of leading large-scale operational improvements, capital projects, and process transformation initiatives with measurable results
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, Manufacturing, or a related environment
Experience leading multiple functional areas, such as Engineering, Maintenance, Distribution, Logistics, or Facilities
Experience managing departmental budgets, resource allocation, and capital expenditure planning, including ROI analysis
Strong understanding of preventative and predictive maintenance, warehouse operations, distribution systems, and inventory control
Experience implementing automation, operational technology, and continuous improvement initiatives
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering, or a related field

Preferred

Master's degree in a related field
Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and process optimization principles
Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on operational execution and to influence change across cross-functional teams

If you are a strategic, hands-on leader who is energized by modernizing operations and leading transformational change, we would welcome the opportunity to connect. Apply now, and a member of the Talentfoot team will be in touch should your track record of success, experience, skills, and qualifications match our client's requirements.

Talentfoot Executive Search specializes in future proofing organizations by securing forward-thinking leaders across sales, marketing, eCommerce, product, data, operations, finance, and technology with a track record of accelerating growth, innovation, and profitability. Since 2010, we've partnered with more than 2,500 companies and lead the industry with a 98% client success rate. Learn more at Talentfoot.com

added.title: Head of Engineering Design
added.description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Position Summary

The Head of Engineering Design leads the engineering organization responsible for the design, development and integration of aircraft modifications across a mixed portfolio of aircraft platforms from twin engine turboprops to large jet aircraft. This position provides technical and organizational leadership for multidisciplinary engineering teams delivering complex aircraft modification programs, including (but not limited too) structural, mechanical, electrical, avionics, mission systems and cabins for special-mission integrations. These integrations support operations around the globe in various regulatory environments. The Head of Engineering Design is accountable for engineering design quality, technical execution, resource planning, schedule performance, regulatory compliance, and alignment with business and customer objectives.

The Head of Engineering Design will bring substantial aircraft modification experience, strong engineering judgment, and a demonstrated ability to lead teams through technically complex, safety-critical, and highly regulated programs.

What You'll Do

Engineering Leadership

Lead, develop, and manage multidisciplinary aircraft modification engineering teams across structural, mechanical, electrical, avionics, systems, and related technical disciplines
Establish clear organizational priorities, accountabilities, performance expectations, and development plans for engineering leaders and individual contributors
Build engineering capability through workforce planning, succession planning, technical mentoring, targeted hiring, and professional development
Promote a culture of technical rigor, ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational accountability
Ensure engineering teams are appropriately staffed and organized to support current programs, new business opportunities, and long-term strategic objectives

Aircraft Modification Execution

Provide executive-level oversight of aircraft modification programs from concept development through design, certification, installation, testing, delivery, and continued operational support
Ensure modification designs meet customer requirements, airworthiness standards, internal engineering requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations
Oversee engineering work related to aircraft structures, systems integration, avionics, electrical systems, mechanical systems, interiors, mission equipment, and special-purpose modifications
Review program status, technical risks, resource requirements, design maturity, and engineering deliverables and develop mitigations as appropriate to ensure on time, budget and performance delivery
Ensure aircraft modification designs are aligned with Metrea’s broader objectives in developing APUS compliant scalable solutions
Establish effective engineering planning, design review, verification, validation, and technical approval processes
Partner with Program Management and Operations to resolve technical issues affecting schedule, cost, installation, testing, or aircraft delivery

Certification and Airworthiness Adherence

Ensure aircraft modifications are designed and developed in accordance with applicable FAA, EASA, UK CAA, military, customer and other regulatory requirements
Partner closely with Certification, Airworthiness, Quality and other key personnel to develop and execute certification strategies
Support certification programs involving STCs, major repairs and alterations, field approvals, conformity activities, and other applicable certification pathways
Ensure engineering data, compliance findings, test plans, substantiation reports, drawings, analyses, and instructions for continued airworthiness meet required standards
Serve as a senior technical interface with regulatory authorities, customers, suppliers, and external engineering partners when required

Technical Governance and Quality

Establish and maintain engineering standards, procedures, design practices, technical authority structures, and approval processes
Ensure technical decisions are supported by appropriate analysis, testing, documentation, and sound engineering judgment
Lead or support formal design reviews, technical reviews, safety assessments, root-cause investigations, and corrective-action efforts
Ensure compliance with configuration management, document control, product safety, quality-management, export-control, and information-security requirements
Monitor engineering quality indicators and implement corrective actions when performance, compliance, or technical standards are not being met
Strengthen lessons-learned, knowledge-management, and continuous-improvement practices across the engineering organization

Capability Area and File Partnership

Support proposal development, technical estimating, statements of work, schedules, staffing plans, and risk assessments
Provide technical input into bid, no-bid, make, buy, and investment decisions
Assess the technical feasibility, certification complexity, resource requirements, and delivery risk of new aircraft modification opportunities
Ensure engineering commitments are realistic, appropriately resourced, and aligned with contractual and business expectations
Communicate program risks, resource constraints, technical decisions, and required leadership actions clearly and promptly

Financial and Resource Management

Develop and manage engineering budgets, staffing plans, labor forecasts, and capital or tool requirements
Dynamically balance resources across competing programs and priorities while informing and managing stakeholders as appropriately aligned with Enterprise objectives
Identify opportunities to improve engineering efficiency, standardization, reuse, and delivery performance without compromising safety or compliance
Manage consultants, suppliers, and external engineering resources as needed

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in aerospace engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline
Minimum 10 or more years of progressively responsible aerospace engineering experience
Significant experience supporting aircraft modification, integration, certification, or major repair programs, ideally in special mission aviation
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams through complex aircraft modification programs
Strong knowledge of aircraft design, systems integration, airworthiness, certification, and configuration-management principles
Experience working with FAA certification requirements and applicable regulations including for both Part-23 and Part-25 aircraft, along with ideal experience of operating in other regulatory environments (EASA, CASA etc.)
Experience developing or supporting certification plans, compliance data, engineering substantiation, testing, conformity, and approval activities
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple programs, competing priorities, technical risks, and resource constraints
Strong leadership, communication, decision-making, and stakeholder-management skills
Experience working directly with customers, regulatory representatives, senior leaders, and cross-functional teams
Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

Master’s degree in engineering, business, aviation management, or a related field
Prior experience in a senior engineering manager, chief engineer, director, or equivalent technical leadership role
Experience as an ODA Unit Member, Designated Engineering Representative, technical specialist, compliance engineer, or certification lead
Experience with Supplemental Type Certificate programs and complex aircraft integration efforts
Experience supporting special-mission, defense, intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, VIP, commercial, cargo, or other highly modified aircraft
Familiarity with systems safety, human factors, environmental qualification, software, and airborne electronic hardware standards, as applicable
Experience in an AS9100 or similarly regulated quality-management environment
Experience supporting Department of Defense, federal, international, or export-controlled programs
Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, DFARS, cybersecurity, and customer-specific security requirements
Active or previously held U.S. security clearance, where relevant to the program portfolio

Benefits

Comprehensive medical plan options
HSA / FSA accounts
Dental and vision coverage
6% employer 401(k) match
Fully paid parental leave for all new parents
Generous PTO
Life and disability insurance
Long-term and Short-term disability coverage
AD&D Coverage
Pet Insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Subsided gym membership / plans through Wellhub   

Work Authorization / Security Clearance

Applicants must be a US citizen.

AAP / EEO Statement

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time exempt position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Hours and work shifts may change in accordance with department and business needs. Exempt Employees must have the ability to be on-call and available, as business needs require.

Work Environment

This job operates in an office setting.

Travel

25%

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. added.title: Head of Data Platform | Frontier AI Research Lab
added.description:
An extremely well-funded AI research lab training frontier foundation models wants a hands-on technical leader to build and run its Data Platform team. This team owns the data backbone behind research, training and production: ingestion, processing and orchestration across the whole data lifecycle.

This is for someone who earned their credibility as a staff or principal engineer and now wants to multiply it through a team. You will set technical direction, hire and coach a team of about 10, and still be in the design reviews and the code where it matters most.

What you will do

Build, mentor and grow a team of about 10 data platform engineers, and raise the bar with every hire.
Set the platform's technical direction: batch and streaming ingestion, scalable compute and storage, and reproducible pipelines with versioning, backfills (reprocessing historical data) and isolated execution.
Work with research, training and production teams so they can run experiments quickly on one shared data layer.
Put trusted data quality, lineage (where data came from and how it changed) and governance in place, so teams can make production decisions with confidence.
Keep cost and performance predictable through guardrails, budgets and ongoing tuning.

The stack

Spark, Flink, Beam, Airflow, Dagster, Kafka, Pub/Sub, Parquet, Iceberg, Delta Lake, BigQuery, Snowflake, Great Expectations, lakehouse and warehouse architectures.

What they are looking for

10+ years in engineering with a strong data engineering foundation, including owning production pipelines that move tens of terabytes to petabytes a day.
A track record as a staff or principal-level IC (individual contributor) before moving into leadership.
Experience managing a team of 5 to 10, or clear readiness to build one quickly while staying technical.
Depth in at least one of: ingestion and orchestration at scale, lakehouse formats and query engines, or data quality, lineage and reproducibility, with working breadth across the others.
A history of building new systems from scratch rather than maintaining legacy ones.
A strong bias to action, and comfort working across research and infrastructure.

What is on offer

Top-of-market salary plus meaningful equity.
Comprehensive health cover, generous paid parental leave and flexible time off.
Visa sponsorship for exceptional candidates.
A small, talent-dense team where this hire shapes the data foundation of frontier model training.
Opportunity to be part of a potential generational company

If you have built data platforms at petabyte scale and want to lead one under frontier AI research, message me directly or apply. All conversations are confidential.

added.title: Senior Director, AI Engineering
added.description:
See yourself at Dataminr

Dataminr is searching for a visionary Senior Director of AI Engineering to lead and inspire the team of engineers building the AI and data engine powering Dataminr’s real-time intelligence platform . This pivotal role demands a leader who can bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and scalable, real-world product deployment. You will drive technical strategies that translate complex AI, Deep Learning and Machine Learning innovations into tangible business impact. We are seeking a candidate with a strong technical foundation and a proven ability to deliver high-quality, end-to-end AI solutions. You are passionate about tackling challenging AI problems, fostering collaboration across product and research teams, and empowering your team to build products that make a meaningful, real-world difference. This US-based role can be remote or based out of our New York City office.

AI Innovation at Dataminr

Working at Dataminr you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.
Regenerative AI:
our AI technology, ReGenAI, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here.
Agentic AI:
we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here
Multimodal AI:
our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here.
The opportunity

Oversee all technical aspects of how different AI models’ outputs impact the quality of content produced by our AI platform. This includes working with PMs and different parts of the business to define proper performance requirements for different Deep Learning and Machine Learning models.
Work closely with scientists, engineers, and product managers to drive and deliver state of the art solutions at scale in multiple areas relevant to real-time detection of events in public data sources (NLP, CV, IR, Knowledge Graphs, etc).
Define and track quality and cost metrics for models as well as for their integrated end-to-end performance in relation to key business goals.
Hands-on modification of workflows, evaluations, and outputs of models.
Lead other engineers and scientists, directing changes to technical approaches.
Excel in placing a human-centered focus on the work (context, end-user impact, etc), finding solutions that work in practice, and have significant impact.

What You Bring

At Dataminr, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed. 6 Bullets max
Strong technical background required: graduate degree in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering.
At least 7 years of industry experience as a software engineer in a cloud-native environment (AWS, Kubernetes).
At least 5 years experience leading software engineers in an AI team.
Experience with deep learning frameworks, LLMs, agent harnesses, compound AI systems (PyTorch, Langfuse, LangGraph, Weaviate, A2A, etc)
Hands-on experience in developing and deploying Machine Learning/Deep Learning/LLMs at large scale in NLP, CV, IR, or a related field, preferably in a real-time setting.
Demonstrated track record of driving and delivering on multiple complex AI projects.
Excellent communication skills.
Deep understanding of research stages, and the ability to connect multiple complex technologies in end-to-end solutions.

About Dataminr

At Dataminr, we are a mission driven team of talented builders, creators and visionaries who have real-world impact on how organizations are able to respond to events. Dataminr’s groundbreaking, AI-powered, intelligence platform provides organizations with the earliest signals of emerging risks, events, and threats before they unfold. Trusted by two-thirds of the Fortune 50 and half of the Fortune 100, Dataminr’s platform analyzes billions of public data inputs spanning text, image, video, audio and sensor data across 150+ languages, empowering our clients to stay one step ahead in an increasingly complex world where every second counts.
Founded in 2009, we have pioneered the world’s first real-time event detection platform, long before the recent Gen AI ‘boom.’ Dataminr operates all around the world united by our passion to use AI for the greater good, be agents of positive change and put our technology into the hands of clients charged with the responsibility to keep organizations running and keep people safe.
As our employees focus on developing our revolutionary technology, we focus on our employees. Dataminr is proud to offer a variety of flexible work arrangements, offices all over the world to foster collaboration, generous PTO and sick leave, and more, as part of our competitive benefits package aimed at keeping all our employees happy and healthy. Explore all our benefits here
.
We believe our differences give us strength. Our employees are empowered to be their best, authentic selves through various opportunities, such as our robust employee resource group (ERG) network, manager development programming, professional development funds, and more.
We serve a global community made up of many cultures and strive to reflect the world and clients we serve, with a workforce built on merit and equity. We actively condemn racism and discrimination in any form. We stand for social good, fostering a culture of allyship, and standing up for those who face systemic barriers to equality. We lead with empathy and strive to be agents of positive change in our company and in our communities.
The annual base salary range for this position is $229,600 - $337,000. You will also be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus and Company equity. Actual salary will be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, applicant skills, and prior relevant experience.
Dataminr is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Individuals seeking employment at Dataminr are considered without regards to race, sex, color, creed, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetics, marital status, pregnancy, unemployment status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status.

added.title: THECB - Director of Data Engineering (ITS)
added.description:
About the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board

The Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board (THECB) works to ensure that all Texans have access to high-quality, affordable higher education opportunities that prepare students for successful careers and strengthen the state's workforce and economy. Through collaboration with colleges, universities, policymakers, and education partners across Texas, THECB advances initiatives that expand educational opportunity, promote student success, and support the future of higher education.
About Information Technology Services

The Information Technology Services (ITS) Division advances THECB's mission by delivering secure, reliable, and customer-focused technology services that enable agency staff to effectively serve Texas students, institutions, and communities.
Our organization is committed to operational excellence through modern technology, strong governance, strategic partnerships, and continuous improvement. We are modernizing how technology services are delivered by strengthening infrastructure and operational resilience, advancing cloud-first and hybrid infrastructure, improving platform reliability and security, and building a culture centered on accountability, collaboration, innovation, and service excellence.
At THECB, we believe technology is more than infrastructure and support. It is a strategic business partner that enables our agency to better serve students, institutions, and the State of Texas.
About the Role

The Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board is seeking an experienced and collaborative technology leader to serve as the Director of Data Engineering. Reporting to the Senior Director of Technology, this position is a key member of the Information Technology Services leadership team and provides strategic leadership and oversight for the agency's data engineering and analytics function, including enterprise data platform delivery and modernization initiatives.
The Director is responsible for ensuring the reliable, secure, and scalable delivery of data solutions that enable agency business operations and advance THECB's mission, strategic priorities, and service objectives. This position establishes the strategic direction for data engineering and analytics by developing goals, objectives, technical standards, procedures, engineering practices, and performance measures that promote reliable, high-quality, and efficient delivery of data platforms and analytics capabilities across the agency.
Responsibilities include directing the delivery of enterprise data engineering, data integration, and analytics services; overseeing data platform and architecture planning, engineering standards, resource alignment, and continuous delivery improvement initiatives; and providing leadership for engineering governance, operational compliance, and organizational change.
Working collaboratively with ITS leadership, IT Operations, Product Engineering, Product Management, IT Service Delivery, the Project Management Office (PMO), agency stakeholders, and the agency's data governance function, the Director helps align data engineering priorities with business needs while ensuring consistent, efficient, and high-quality delivery of data platforms and analytics capabilities across the agency.
This position supervises management and professional staff and exercises significant initiative and independent judgment while serving as a trusted advisor on data engineering, analytics, and data platform modernization.
Why Join Our Team

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape how data platforms and analytics capabilities are engineered, modernized, and delivered at the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board.
As a member of the ITS leadership team, you'll play a critical role in advancing data platform modernization, strengthening data engineering practices, expanding trusted analytics capabilities, and building a high-performing team focused on delivering reliable, secure, and scalable data solutions.
In this role, you'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the evolution of data engineering, enterprise data platforms, and analytics delivery across the agency.
Build, mentor, and develop high-performing data engineers, analytics engineers, and managers while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Build and evolve the agency's enterprise data platform on modern cloud technologies, including Snowflake and Power BI.
Establish engineering standards, data architecture practices, and performance measures that improve data quality and reliability and support executive decision-making.
Strengthen the partnership between IT Operations, Product Engineering, Product Management, the PMO, and data governance to deliver integrated platforms and shared ownership of outcomes.
Make a lasting impact by helping technology enable the agency's mission of expanding educational opportunity and supporting higher education across Texas.
If you are passionate about developing people, building modern data platforms, turning data into trusted insight, and delivering data and analytics solutions that create measurable business value, we encourage you to apply.
General Description:

Performs highly advanced (senior-level) managerial work for the Information Technology Services (ITS) Division of the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board (THECB). Serving as the Director of Data Engineering, this position provides strategic leadership and oversight for the agency's data engineering and analytics function, including enterprise data platform delivery and modernization initiatives. The position is responsible for ensuring the reliable, secure, and scalable delivery of data solutions that enable agency business operations and advance the agency's mission, strategic priorities, and service objectives.
Work involves establishing strategic plans, goals, and objectives for data engineering and analytics; developing technical standards, procedures, and engineering practices; and establishing priorities, performance measures, and evaluation tools to assess operational effectiveness, data quality, and data platform reliability.
Responsibilities include directing the delivery of enterprise data engineering, data integration, and analytics services; overseeing data platform and architecture planning, engineering standards, resource alignment, and continuous delivery improvement initiatives; and providing leadership for engineering governance, operational compliance, and organizational change. Collaborates with ITS leadership and agency stakeholders, including IT Operations, Product Engineering, Product Management, IT Service Delivery, the Project Management Office (PMO), and the agency's data governance function, to align data engineering priorities with business needs and ensure consistent, efficient, and high-quality delivery of data platforms and analytics capabilities across the agency.
Supervises the work of others, including management and professional staff. Works under minimal supervision, with extensive latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment. This position reports to the Senior Director of Technology. Performs other duties as assigned.
General Duties and Responsibilities:

Strategic People Leadership & Talent Strategy ¿ Leads managers, senior individual contributors, or a combination of both by setting leadership expectations, supporting performance management, and guiding workforce and succession planning. Develops leadership capability and subject-matter expertise; aligns talent to strategic needs; and fosters a culture of accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Strategic Execution, Governance & Resource Alignment ¿ Defines and oversees execution of strategies within assigned domains by establishing goals, priorities, standards, and performance measures. Aligns budgets, staffing, and resources to objectives; ensures compliance and governance; and monitors organizational performance to achieve agency outcomes.
Enterprise Data Engineering & Platform Leadership ¿ Directs the design, development, and operation of the agency's enterprise data platforms, pipelines, and integration services that collect, transform, and deliver data for operational and analytical use. Establishes engineering standards and performance expectations to ensure data solutions are reliable, secure, scalable, and supportable in support of agency programs and mission-critical activities.
Data Architecture, Standards & Governance Implementation ¿ Establishes and maintains technical data architecture, data modeling, integration, and engineering standards, aligned with the agency's enterprise data strategy, that guide the design and evolution of agency data platforms. Implements the technical controls, such as data quality validation, lineage, metadata, access management, and retention, that put agency data governance policies into practice, in coordination with the agency's data governance function, to ensure data assets remain reliable, secure, and audit-ready.
Enterprise Analytics & Decision Support Enablement ¿ Directs the engineering and delivery of enterprise analytics, reporting, and decision-support capabilities, including curated data products, semantic models, dashboards, and self-service tools. Ensures enterprise data assets are trusted, well documented, and readily usable to provide actionable insights that support operational management, performance measurement, and strategic decision-making across the agency.
Stakeholder Collaboration & Organizational Alignment ¿ Collaborates with agency leadership, IT teams, and business units to align data engineering priorities and platform investments with organizational needs. Partners with IT Operations, Product Engineering, Product Management, IT Service Delivery, and the PMO to deliver integrated platforms and services, and facilitates cross-functional coordination to ensure data initiatives support agency programs, reporting needs, and mission outcomes.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Knowledge Skills or Abilities:

Knowledge of modern data architecture and engineering practices, including data warehousing, data lake and lakehouse designs, and batch and streaming pipelines.
Knowledge of enterprise data platform modernization strategies, including cloud-based, SaaS, managed data services, and commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) solutions.
Knowledge of cloud data platforms and enterprise integration technologies, such as Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or comparable solutions.
Knowledge of enterprise analytics, business intelligence, and data visualization platforms and tools, such as Power BI or comparable solutions.
Knowledge of DataOps, product-oriented delivery models, and Agile practices within enterprise environments.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, security, and compliance practices, including metadata management, lineage, and data privacy requirements.
Skill in leading data engineering, integration, and analytics teams delivering across custom-built, SaaS, and cloud-native data platforms.
Skill in aligning data architecture and engineering execution with the agency's data strategy, product strategy, and business priorities.
Skill in evaluating and guiding build versus buy decisions and platform selection within enterprise environments.
Skill in providing hands-on technical leadership, including guiding design, reviewing solutions, and supporting teams through complex challenges.
Skill in coaching and developing engineers and managers to improve technical capability and delivery practices.
Skill in translating business and analytical needs into reliable, well-documented data products, pipelines, and reporting solutions.
Skill in collaborating effectively across IT Operations, Product Engineering, Product Management, IT Service Delivery, PMO, data governance, business, and executive stakeholders.
Ability to provide strategic direction for data engineerin

added.title: Sr Director, Enterprise Data and AI Platform
added.description:
Dayforce is a global human capital management (HCM) company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and Minneapolis, Minnesota, with operations across North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), and the Asia Pacific Japan (APJ) region.

Our award-winning Cloud HCM platform offers a unified solution database and continuous calculation engine, driving efficiency, productivity and compliance for the global workforce.

Our brand promise - Makes Work Life Better™ - Reflects our commitment to employees, customers, partners and communities globally.

About The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Sr. Director, Enterprise Data and AI Platform to define and execute the strategy, architecture, and delivery of Dayforce's enterprise data, AI, and contextual intelligence capabilities. This leader will drive the evolution of our modern data ecosystem, enabling trusted, scalable, and AI-ready data solutions that support business functions across Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Customer Success, Support, Services, Legal, and other enterprise organizations.

This role is responsible for architecting and evolving our Enterprise Data Foundation on Microsoft Fabric and Azure, enabling advanced analytics, machine learning, and enterprise reporting. In addition, this leader will architect and build the Enterprise Context Layer—a trusted semantic and knowledge platform that unifies business context, metadata, governance, permissions, and enterprise knowledge to power analytics, intelligent automation, AI agents, and next-generation conversational experiences.

As part of this transformation, the role will lead the strategy and implementation of the Enterprise Agentic AI Platform, enabling employees to interact with enterprise data through secure, AI-powered conversational experiences that complement and, over time, transform traditional dashboards and reporting.

The successful candidate will lead a global organization of data, AI platform, and engineering professionals, including managers, direct reports, and external partners. This highly strategic yet hands-on leadership role requires deep technical expertise, strong architectural vision, exceptional cross-functional leadership, and a passion for delivering innovative, AI-driven solutions that accelerate business outcomes.

This position reports to the VP, Enterprise Data, Analytics and Governance.

What You'll Get To Do

Enterprise Data, AI & Context Leadership

Lead and grow the global Enterprise Data, AI Platform, and Context Engineering organization.
Define the long-term strategy and roadmap for the Enterprise Data Foundation, Enterprise Context Layer, and Enterprise AI Platform.
Own the architecture, execution, and evolution of enterprise data, semantic, knowledge, and AI platforms.
Lead delivery of large-scale, cross-functional data engineering and AI transformation initiatives.

Enterprise Data Foundation & Modern Data Platform

Lead enterprise data engineering, ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and data product development.
Design scalable, secure, and governed data platforms supporting analytics, AI, and operational workloads.
Ensure high availability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence across enterprise data platforms.

Enterprise Context Layer & Knowledge Architecture

Architect and build the Enterprise Context Layer, including semantic models, business knowledge, metadata, permissions, and enterprise context services.
Drive enterprise standards for semantic modeling, metadata management, knowledge architecture, and reusable context services.
Enable trusted business context that powers analytics, AI agents, intelligent automation, and enterprise applications.

Enterprise AI Platform & Conversational Experiences

Define the enterprise AI platform strategy, architecture, and technology roadmap.
Lead implementation of Agentic AI platforms, orchestration frameworks, RAG solutions, vector search, MCP services, and intelligent automation capabilities.
Lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of enterprise conversational AI experiences that enable natural language interaction with enterprise data.
Partner with the Decision Intelligence team to deliver AI assistants that leverage trusted enterprise context and progressively replace traditional dashboards and reports.
Establish enterprise MLOps and LLMOps practices for machine learning and generative AI, including model lifecycle management, prompt and model evaluation, monitoring, observability, retraining, and responsible AI governance.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and establish enterprise AI architecture, governance, and security standards.

Governance, Security & Architecture

Define and enforce enterprise data governance, security, and AI governance practices.
Define standards and governance for AI model lifecycle management, including model registry, monitoring, explainability, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
Ensure data availability, protection, compliance, and SLA performance across enterprise platforms.
Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) governance and enterprise technology strategy.
Manage platform budgets, vendor relationships, and strategic technology partnerships.

Skills And Experience We Value

10+ years of experience leading enterprise data, AI platform, or engineering organizations.
Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale transformation initiatives and manage complex programs, budgets, and vendor relationships.
Strong business partnership, executive communication, and change management skills.
Expertise in modern data platforms, including Azure Cloud, Microsoft Fabric, Data Lake/Warehouse/Mesh, data integration technologies, Power BI, and Tableau.
Strong understanding of enterprise context management, metadata management, ontology design, and semantic modeling.
Knowledge of Agile methodologies, particularly SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework).
Skilled at cross-functional collaboration and aligning technology delivery with enterprise priorities.

What Would Make You Stand Out

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
Experience designing enterprise semantic layers, knowledge graphs, metadata platforms, and enterprise knowledge management solutions.
Experience building enterprise AI platforms utilizing RAG, vector databases, MCP, Agentic AI, and conversational AI architectures.
Experience implementing Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and enterprise MLOps/LLMOps frameworks, including model registry, deployment, monitoring, and governance.
Proven experience delivering enterprise conversational analytics and AI-powered business experiences.
Demonstrated ability to translate business knowledge into reusable, AI-ready data and context models.
Deep understanding of enterprise AI operational practices, including model governance, observability, responsible AI, and continuous delivery of machine learning and generative AI solutions.

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Director, Engineering – Advanced Development

The Opportunity

At SharkNinja, we're redefining how products improve everyday life — and this role sits at the very heart of that ambition.

As Director, Engineering – Advanced Development, you'll head up a team of passionate, hands-on design storytellers, engineers, and inventors who bring breakthrough product ideas to life. This isn't just a design leadership role. It's owning the spark behind SharkNinja's next generation of iconic products: you'll be the creative catalyst shaping what's next, driving how teams turn blue-sky thinking into tangible, consumer-loved innovations that define categories. The early concept architecture your team shapes is what eventually fuels mass production through our NPD pipeline.

We're looking for a designer at heart — engineering and design credentials, a natural flair for storytelling, and a relentless passion for solving consumer problems in inventive, inspiring ways.

What You'll Do

Own early-stage concept development, design storytelling, and early platform exploration across multiple product categories.
Pitch future-focused concepts through design storytelling — in a way that connects emotionally and drives alignment across the business, including with senior leadership.
Partner with Mechanical Engineering, R&D, Product Development, and Product Marketing leadership to ensure early concepts are rooted in a strong, scalable product strategy.

Build, inspire, and lead a team of managers, engineers, and designers, fostering a culture of curiosity, experimentation, and excellence.

Serve as a key voice in long-term innovation strategy and category vision, in partnership with senior cross-functional leaders.

with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community.

added.title: Director of Engineering, Flex Compute
added.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence . As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

Power, not silicon, is the binding constraint on AI infrastructure. Crusoe is vertically integrated from electrons to tokens; generation, batteries, controls, and the cloud orchestration layer which means we can credibly commit flexible load to utilities and deliver on it. No other AI cloud can.

Flexible Compute is the system that makes that real: reducing data-center power draw on demand quickly, reliably, verifiably — while protecting the workloads that matter most. It gets us megawatts sooner, earns more per megawatt, and rides through grid-stress events without breaking SLAs.

You'll operate at the seam between one of the industry's fastest-growing energy footprints and the software that controls it. This is a utility-facing, safety-critical control system, and a ground-up build. You’ll define the architecture, ship the first production system, and build the team from scratch.

What You'll Be Working On:

Own the curtailment orchestration and decision layer: grid-signal ingestion, staged shedding, per-SKU power capping without ever silently dropping a paid workload
Land a utility-validated pilot: fast ramp to setpoint, tight accuracy, high-fidelity telemetry, and the test harness that proves it before we commit to a utility
Deliver dynamic power management for oversubscription — more GPUs per megawatt with no customer-visible impact
Build fast, workload-aware GPU power estimation, validated against fleet telemetry : the engine behind shed forecasting, oversubscription admission, and power planning for new silicon
Design for safety: authenticated signal ingress, bounded blast radius, fail-safe defaults, manual backstops
Own graceful ride-through of power-loss and grid-stress events, integrated with on-site battery and generation backstops
Partner deeply with Data Center Engineering (mechanical, electrical, controls) and Energy teams on interconnection commitments, curtailment program design, and BESS/generation integration.
Integrate with our cloud control plane across Kubernetes and Slurm fleets : one control plane, not two
Make build-vs-leverage calls across vendor power-management stacks and grid integration layers
Hire and lead the team from the ground up, keeping headcount sublinear to fleet growth through automation

What You'll Bring to the Team:

12+ years in software engineering, including 5+ leading engineering teams, ideally taking a system from 0→1 to production scale
Deep experience with distributed control planes, orchestration, or fleet automation (e.g., Temporal, Kubernetes, Slurm)
A track record with safety-critical or physically-actuating systems, where a misfire has a bounded, designed-for worst case
Working knowledge of data-center power systems: utility interconnection, switchgear/UPS/BESS, rack/PDU distribution, power telemetry, and GPU power management
Experience with energy markets or grid programs demand response, curtailable-load tariffs, ISO/RTO market signals (e.g., ERCOT, PJM, CAISO) or demonstrated speed to fluency in them
Strong build-vs-buy judgment and comfort deciding with incomplete data
A record of hiring senior engineers and running healthy operations for systems that must never fail silently

Bonus Points

GPU cluster operations or AI cloud infrastructure experience
Prior work in the energy sector: power generation, storage, utility software, or grid-scale controls
Background in GPU power/performance modeling, DVFS, or turning research prototypes into production systems
Experience with checkpoint/preemption for large training jobs or power-aware scheduling

Benefits:

Competitive compensation and equity packages
Restricted Stock Units
Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
Employer contributions to HSA account
Paid parental leave
Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
Professional development & tuition reimbursement
Mental health & wellness support
Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
Cell phone stipend
401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
Volunteer time off
Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
Daily meals allowance
Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $285,000 - $335,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Exceptional communication skills with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional partner teams, executive leadership, and customer design partners.

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.
